Frappe ERPNext 6.26.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns stock data without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read per-warehouse and company-wide stock quantities and confirm item existence.

Frappe ERPNext 4.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns the taxes and charges of documents without checking record permissions. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no roles, can request arbitrary document types and records to read tax rows beyond their permitted scope.

Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that allows authenticated users to read Taxes and Charges Template rows without permission checks. Attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read account heads and tax rates.

Frappe ERPNext 5.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Projects module endpoint that returns employee costing and billing rates without record-level permission checks. Authenticated users, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other employees' activity cost rates.
An issue in the TP-Link MQTT Broker and API gateway of TP-Link Kasa KP125M v1.0.3 and Tapo P125M v1.0.2 allows attackers to establish connections by impersonating devices owned by other users.

Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Bank Transaction metadata of other companies without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to retrieve that metadata.

Frappe ERPNext 15.87.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that changes Period Closing Voucher job status without permission checks and accepts a request method triggerable cross-site. Authenticated users without an Accounts role, or cross-site pages opened by authenticated users, can send requests naming a scheduled job to stop accounting jobs from completing.

Frappe ERPNext 14.44.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module's payment unreconciliation endpoint, which does not check the caller's permission on the vouchers it unreconciles. Authenticated users with the Accounts User role can send crafted Unreconcile Payment requests naming vouchers from other companies or outside their User Permissions to remove their reconciliation.

A vulnerability was determined in vijaythapa333 django-student-management-system up to 0d96e62cc4e996e3e77bec1b8e3da3980edf8889. This affects the function get_students of the file StaffViews.py of the component Take Attendance Staff Dashboard. This manipulation of the argument first_name causes cross site scripting. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. This product is using a rolling release to provide continious delivery. Therefore, no version details for affected nor updated releases are available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

GFI HelpDesk before 4.99.13 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the archiver export feature that allows authenticated attackers with administrator privileges to execute arbitrary SQL queries by supplying crafted itemid[] array values to /admin/index.php?/archiver/Manager/ExportAll. The Controller_Manager.ExportAll() method joins the itemid values with implode() and GetWhere() concatenates them into an IN() clause without sanitization or parameterization, and DumpTables() executes the resulting query against each ticket-related table, allowing attackers to read or modify database contents.

Frappe ERPNext 6.18.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Payment Requests that lets authenticated Accounts User role holders read source documents they lack permission to access. Attackers can create a Payment Request through the generic record interface that references another company's document, then email its loaded content to an address they choose.

Frappe ERPNext 6.3.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint used to choose a Tax Rule, which returns party address details without permission checks. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming arbitrary customers, suppliers, or Addresses to obtain their city, state, postal code, and country.

Frappe ERPNext 8.2.5 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in Manufacturing module endpoints that check only document-type write access, not permission on each Work Order. Authenticated users restricted by User Permissions can send crafted requests naming another company's Work Order to stop, resume or close it.

Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns Payment Entries for a readable bank record without checking read permission on each Payment Entry. Authenticated users with an Accounts role can request a readable record to obtain metadata of Payment Entries excluded by their user permissions, such as Cost Center restrictions.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in xmt_resolve_od_links() that allows attackers to corrupt stack memory via over-long object descriptor URL fragments. Attackers can craft an XMT scene file whose URL fragment overflows the fixed 5000-byte szURL buffer via sprintf, crashing MP4Box when a user loads it.

Frappe Framework before 15.120.1 and 16.x before 16.33.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in file attachment handling that permits arbitrary file read. Authenticated attackers holding a single ordinary role without write permissions can abuse attachment handling to read server files outside the application boundary.

free5GC SMF through 1.4.6 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in HandlePDUSessionSMContextCreate that leaves CHF charging sessions open when PCF session rule application fails. Attackers can repeatedly trigger failed PDU session establishments to accumulate orphaned charging sessions on the CHF and degrade its availability.

A flaw was found in the GLib DMA-BUF path of WebKitGTK. The UIProcess trusted fds.size() as the DMA-BUF plane count when handling AcceleratedBackingStore::DidCreateDMABufBuffer and copied offsets and strides without verifying that those vectors had the same length. A compromised WebProcess can send mismatched vector lengths, causing an out-of-bounds read in the privileged UIProcess. This can disclose UIProcess memory and crash the UIProcess, and may be used as part of a Web Content sandbox-escape chain.

AzuraCast 0.19.0 before 0.24.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows users with station media rights to add tracks to other stations' playlists by supplying foreign playlist ids to the single-file edit endpoint. Attackers can send sequential playlist ids in the playlists array to inject entries into other stations' AutoDJ rotations and public now-playing metadata, causing failed playback slots.

Rclone from 1.51.0 before 1.76.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in serve sftp --auth-proxy because the generateCacheKey cache key omits the authentication method. Attackers knowing a victim's base64 public key can submit it as a password from the same client IP to reuse the cached entry and gain read-write VFS access.

LiteLLM Proxy 1.62.4 before 1.84.0 contains a callback injection vulnerability that allows authenticated API key holders to register process-wide logging callbacks by supplying callbacks fields in request bodies. Attackers can name an unenabled observability integration such as langsmith or langfuse to leak all users' prompts and responses, or suppress operator logging via litellm_disabled_callbacks.

ERPSaaS 3.7.9 through 3.47.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated company users to inject script markup through unescaped client and company address fields. Attackers can store script in address lines rendered by getFormattedAddressHtml() via unescaped Blade output, executing in browsers of users viewing, previewing or printing invoices and estimates.

OpenCV through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in YAMLParser::parse that allows attackers to cause denial of service via crafted YAML dash lines. Attackers can supply YAML files with a non-separator '-' line after the first document, opened through cv::FileStorage, to hang the thread at full CPU.

Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in rpl_remove_routes_by_nexthop() in the RPL-Classic implementation that allows adjacent attackers to crash nodes. Attackers participating in the RPL network can create a stale route whose next-hop neighbor entry was removed, then trigger parent removal to crash the node.

Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in icmp_in() in os/net/ipv6/multicast/mpl.c that allows unauthenticated attackers to hang nodes via crafted MPL control messages. Attackers on the same link can send an MPL data message to create a seed entry, then an all-zero bit vector control message causing index wraparound and denial of service.

LibreCAD through 2.2.1.6 contains an out-of-bounds access vulnerability in picPunto::processFilePic() of the PIC import plugin that allows attackers to read past QStringList bounds via coordinate tokens lacking commas. Attackers can persuade a user to import a crafted PIC file with malformed line, circle, box or text records to crash the application and potentially modify memory.

Convoy before 26.6.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in /portal-api single-resource handlers that allows portal link token holders to access other tenants' resources by ID. Attackers with another tenant's resource IDs in the same project can read endpoint signing secrets and webhook payloads, rotate secrets, pause or delete endpoints, and force event re-delivery.

Pomerium from 0.30.0 before 0.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the MCP token endpoint that skips client secret verification for client_secret_basic clients. Attackers holding an intercepted authorization code or refresh token can redeem it at /.pomerium/mcp/token with any secret to obtain the victim's access tokens.

Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in glTFAsset.inl that allows attackers to corrupt memory via oversized glTF 1.0 accessor elements. Attackers can supply a crafted glTF 1.0 file with VEC4 position or VEC3 index accessors to overflow heap or stack buffers during import, crashing applications.

Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in PLYImporter::LoadFace and PLYImporter::createFromeTriStrip that fails to validate face vertex indices against the vertex count. Attackers can supply a crafted PLY file whose out-of-range indices cause GenVertexNormalsProcess::GenMeshVertexNormals to write normals outside the heap buffer, crashing the application or potentially enabling code execution.

better-chatbot before 2.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that lets built-in tools run without user confirmation in Manual tool mode, because src/app/api/chat/route.ts keeps their execute handlers. Attackers can plant prompt-injected documents or web pages that make the HTTP request tool send conversation data to attacker-controlled URLs.

actix-files before 0.7.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read hidden files by requesting Windows 8.3 short-name aliases. Attackers can request short names like ENV~1 or GIT~1/config to bypass the leading-dot check in actix_files::Files and retrieve .env secrets and .git contents.

Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ColladaParser::CopyVertex that allows attackers to read heap memory by supplying primitives lacking a VERTEX input. Attackers can provide a crafted Collada file whose SIZE_MAX per-vertex offset bypasses the release-removed ai_assert check, crashing the importing application.

ArcadeDB 25.8.1 before 26.11.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability because per-type ACLs are keyed by type name, renames are not propagated to the permission configuration, and requestAccessOnType allows unknown type names by default. Authenticated users holding only updateSchema can run ALTER TYPE NAME on a denied type to gain read, DELETE and TRUNCATE access, immediately for TIMESERIES types and after the next security rebuild for record-backed types.

ArcadeDB before 26.11.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read schema definitions of denied types through listings ignoring per-type ACLs. Attackers can query the PostgreSQL wire catalog, GraphQL introspection, or MCP get_schema to reveal property names, indexes, inheritance, and materialized view SQL.

Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.8.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows authenticated users to crash the server by uploading extreme-width images as task attachments. Attackers can request the attachment preview endpoint so Lanczos resampling allocates width-proportional weight tables, OOM-killing the process repeatedly with sub-megabyte PNGs.

Worklenz before 3.4.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in GET /api/v1/activity-logs/:id that allows authenticated users to read other teams' task activity logs because it lacks the verifyTaskAccess middleware. Attackers who know another team's task UUID can retrieve reporter and assignee names and avatars plus the full timeline of status, priority, label and estimation changes.

ServerOS Panel before 1.10.1 contains a decompression bomb vulnerability in DeploySourcePacker::extract() that allows authenticated users with manage-machines permission to bypass the 4 GB unpacked-size limit by under-declaring zip entry sizes. Attackers can upload a crafted archive via POST /machines/{machine}/sources whose entries inflate far beyond declared sizes, filling the host disk and denying service to all workspaces.

A flaw was found in the administrative interface of Keycloak, an identity and access management solution. The issue occurs when Fine-Grained Admin Permissions are used to restrict a group administrator from managing specific sub-groups. Due to an incomplete fix for a previous vulnerability, a restricted administrator can bypass these restrictions by moving a forbidden sub-group to the top level of the hierarchy. This allows the attacker to gain unauthorized control over the groups members, potentially leading to a full takeover of the security realm.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an Improper Input Validation vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker with adjacent network access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a denial of service condition.

better-auth from 0.8.1-beta.5 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5, and @better-auth/passkey from 1.6.25 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5, let revoked sessions stay valid because secondary storage session lists are updated non-atomically and some routes trust cookie-cached sessions. An attacker holding a valid session can evade bulk revocation or bans, or use a revoked cached session to register a passkey or create a lasting session.

better-auth 1.4.0 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an improper authentication vulnerability because email-change links record the old and new addresses but not the requesting user. Attackers can open a still-valid link issued for their own account after a victim registers the attacker's released old address, gaining a session and changing the victim's email to one they control.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains a Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a Denial of service.

A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Icon API: Menu submodule of the Drupal 7 Icon API module. When a menu item is configured with the Title Wrapper option enabled, the value of the Title Wrapper Class field is output directly into an HTML attribute without sanitization or escaping. A user with the "administer menu icons" permission can inject a payload such as `title" onmouseover="alert(document.cookie)` that is rendered verbatim on every page displaying the affected menu item, executing arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of any user who interacts with the menu link. This can lead to session theft, account hijacking, and further attacks against site users.

This issue affects Icon API 7.1.0.

In astro-airflow-mcp 0.5.0 through 0.9.1, the af CLI and the MCP server send telemetry from a Python subprocess that can import modules from the current working directory. If a user runs an af command or an MCP tool call from inside a project that contains an attacker-supplied json.py, that file runs with the user's privileges. Users who only run the tool in projects they trust are not affected. Fixed in 0.9.2; in earlier versions, setting AF_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 prevents it.

better-auth 1.3.0 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the admin plugin's /admin/update-user endpoint that lets roles holding user:update change another user's phoneNumber and phoneNumberVerified fields. Attackers can set their own verified phone number on a higher-privileged account and sign in via phone OTP to take it over.

Cloud Mail before 3.6.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in attService.addAtt that allows unauthenticated attackers to store inline attachments with sender-supplied MIME types. Attackers can email SVG or HTML attachments, compute the content-hash URL under /oss/ or /attachments/, and steal session JWTs from localStorage to hijack accounts including administrators.

Budibase is an open-source low-code platform. Prior to 3.50.0, the public POST /api/global/users/init endpoint on a self-hosted single-tenant deployment accepts an attacker-controlled tenantId and evaluates checkAnyUserExists() in the selected tenant database instead of the legitimate default tenant. An unauthenticated attacker can select an unused tenant namespace to bypass the one-time initialization guard, causing packages/worker/src/api/controllers/global/users.ts to create a tenant-specific CouchDB database and a global-administrator document without a session or CSRF token. Repeating this operation with unique tenant identifiers can exhaust datastore resources and leave latent privileged records. The created administrator cannot log into the default tenant while multi-tenancy remains disabled, which limits the immediate impact to persistent writes, denial of service, and records that may become usable during later multi-tenant operation or migration. This issue is fixed in versions 3.50.0 and 4.0.0.

Netatalk is a Free and Open Source file server suite for Unix-like operating systems. Prior to 4.4.3, libatalk/dsi/dsi_stream.c interprets the dsi_code and dsi_doff union field as a data offset for all DSI command types instead of limiting that interpretation to DSIWrite. An unauthenticated client can send a non-WRITE DSIFUNC_CMD packet with a nonzero dsi_code smaller than dsi_len, causing dsi_stream_receive to consume only the dsi_code number of payload bytes and leave attacker-controlled bytes in the readahead buffer. The residual bytes become the next DSI header, allowing protocol desynchronization that can close sessions, corrupt protocol state, or trigger an infinite-read denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 4.4.3.

Netatalk is a Free and Open Source file server suite for Unix-like operating systems. From 2.0.0 until 4.5.1, the DHX2 and DHX2-PAM authentication state machine in etc/uams/uams_dhx2_pam.c permits logincont1 to be invoked again with the same FPLoginCont retID after it has released the global gcry_mpi_t Ra object. When DHX2 or DHX2PAM is enabled in the UAM list, a remote attacker without valid AFP credentials can repeat the first continuation step, causing gcry_mpi_powm to dereference the freed Ra value and gcry_mpi_release to free it again in a privileged afpd worker. The demonstrated result is a repeatable pre-authentication worker crash, and the use-after-free and double-free provide a plausible allocator exploitation primitive although code execution was not demonstrated. This issue is fixed in version 4.5.1.

Logto is the modern, open-source auth infrastructure for SaaS and AI apps. Prior to 1.46.0, social account linking can use an unverified email returned by the standard OAuth 2.0 or Azure AD connector to select an existing local account. When findSocialRelatedUser matches a victim's email and a request to POST /api/experience/identification enables linkSocialIdentity, an attacker who controls that unverified provider email can link an attacker-controlled social identity to the victim account and sign in as the victim. The issue applies when the provider does not verify email ownership or allows the value to be set freely; Google, GitHub, and default OIDC connector behavior is not affected because those paths expose only verified email. Version 1.46.0 adds an opt-in email synchronization control to the standard OAuth 2.0 connector, while the Azure AD connector has offered an equivalent opt-in control since version 1.43.0. These controls preserve existing behavior by default, so administrators must enable them on affected connectors. A configurable mitigation is available in version 1.46.0.

NukeViet CMS is a multi Content Management System. From the 4.x release line until 4.5.09, a low-privileged authenticated user can store script-breaking content in the first_name and last_name profile fields used to form a comment display name. Both reply links in themes/default/modules/comment/comment.tpl interpolate {COMMENT.post_name} into the inline onclick call to nv_commment_feedback(). HTML numeric references produced by Request::_get_title() are decoded by the browser before JavaScript parsing, so clicking Reply can terminate the string and execute attacker-controlled JavaScript in the visitor's origin, including an administrator's session. This issue is fixed in version 4.5.09.

A security vulnerability has been detected in continuedev continue 2.0.0/2.1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is the function getSidebarContent of the file extensions/vscode/src/ContinueGUIWebviewViewProvider.ts of the component Mermaid Diagram Renderer. The manipulation leads to os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A flaw has been found in hankcs HanLP up to 2.1.6. Impacted is the function uncompress of the file hanlp/utils/io_util.py of the component TAR Archive Extraction Handler. This manipulation causes path traversal. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.1.7 is recommended to address this issue. Patch name: feb0f82d12762cf4e687b9926efd90c672857780. You should upgrade the affected component.

Qwik City before 1.20.3 (@builder.io/qwik-city) and @qwik.dev/router before 2.0.0-rc.4 contain an improperly controlled object modification vulnerability in formToObj that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite built-in function properties. Attackers can send a form POST with nested field names traversing inherited members of string values, breaking Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call process-wide until server restart.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains a Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a Denial of service.

probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in lib/parse_stream/avif.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via attacker-declared ftyp or meta box sizes. Attackers can supply an AVIF stream or URL to probe(url) or probe(stream) declaring a huge box length, forcing the parser to buffer all received bytes and causing denial of service.

The WP Import Export Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.9.32 via the 'comment' parameter. This is due to a two-stage shortcode check that evaluates the raw mapping placeholder before data substitution, causing the neutralizer to be skipped when attacker-controlled comment content containing a malicious [wpie_function] shortcode is substituted at runtime. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP callables on the server. Exploitation requires an Administrator to perform the standard Export With Settings For Import followed by a New Import migration workflow, which is a routine operational task; the attacker themselves requires no account or authentication, needing only the ability to submit a pending comment on any comments-open post.

The WPBot – AI ChatBot for WordPress & Growth Suite: SEO, AI Writer, Email Marketing, Social Media plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'text' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is triggered when an administrator opens the Chat Sessions screen, at which point the plugin's bundled Bootstrap 3.3.7 affix data-API passes the attacker-controlled data-target attribute value to jQuery as HTML, executing the injected script in the administrator's session.
vp: wpbot – ai chatbot for wordpress & growth suite: seo, ai writer, email marketing, social media

cves.d: The Admin Columns plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'url' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that an administrator has added the Author URL column to the Comments screen layout and that the site accepts unauthenticated comments, both of which are default WordPress and plugin configurations.

Rocket.Chat's POST /api/v1/chat.sendMessage endpoint improperly validates nested message properties, allowing authenticated users with standard privileges to inject arbitrary message metadata that is persisted and trusted by the server and clients. This can lead to persistent room-level denial of service, stored HTML/iframe injection, unauthorized modification of other users' private starred messages, permission bypass and attribution spoofing for pinned messages, forged edit attribution, and invisible user mentions.

The VikBooking Hotel Booking Engine & PMS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'vbf<field_id>' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.8.20 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The WCFM Membership – WooCommerce Memberships for Multivendor Marketplace plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wcfm_membership_registration_form[store_name]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.12.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The nonce required to reach the registration endpoint is publicly emitted on the /vendor-register/ page, making the endpoint fully reachable by unauthenticated attackers without any prior authentication or privilege escalation.
vp: wcfm membership – woocommerce memberships for multivendor marketplace

cves.d: The Germanized for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.first_name (Store API checkout) → stored on parent order; withdrawal get_first_name() fallback' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload is planted via an unauthenticated guest checkout order's billing first name through the WooCommerce Store API, with execution triggered by a subsequent unauthenticated withdrawal request submission whose nonce is publicly available on the /withdraw-from-contract/ page.

The AutomatorWP – No-Code Workflow Automation, Integration & Webhooks Plugin, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'your-message (any CF7 form field used in a form_field: tag)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.0.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have configured a public 'Guest submits a form' automation whose Send-an-email action embeds a form_field tag, after which the payload fires the next time any user opens the affected automation's email log entry.
vp: automatorwp – no-code workflow automation, integration & webhooks plugin, now with ai

cves.d: The Accept Stripe Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'href of any <a> element containing 'asp_action=show_pp&product_id='' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that a user clicks the attacker-placed comment link to trigger the sink; however, if the non-default 'Prefetch Payment Popup Scripts' option is enabled, execution occurs on page load with no user interaction required.

pypdf 3.7.1 before 7.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows attackers to guess placeholders in encrypted templated documents by analyzing file identifiers. Attackers with a document sharing the same template and access to other documents' file identifiers can recover placeholder contents from encrypted PDFs.

SurrealKV before 1.1.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the safe InternalKeyRef::from_encoded constructor, which only checks key length with a debug-only assertion. Callers passing keys shorter than 16 bytes, or crafted or corrupted SSTable blocks, trigger unchecked length underflow in timestamp(), seq_num() and trailer(), reading heap bytes before the allocation or panicking.

ArcadeDB from 26.11.1-SNAPSHOT before 26.11.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to skip per-type ACL checks when a database is opened on demand. Attackers can send the first POST /api/v1/batch/{database} request to a closed database to read and write types they are not entitled to access.

A vulnerability has been found in hankcs HanLP up to 2.1.6. The affected element is the function RNNLanguageModel.load_language_model of the file hanlp/layers/embeddings/contextual_string_embedding.py. Such manipulation of the argument model_file leads to deserialization. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.1.7 is sufficient to fix this issue. The name of the patch is 6962907e37dfa467fa6dee164b5b1d0a904b24db. The affected component should be upgraded.

better-auth 0.4.12-beta.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the phone number plugin that lets sign-up and other flows save unverified phone numbers, which phone OTP sign-in then uses to select the account. Attackers can attach a victim's number to an attacker-controlled account so the victim's valid OTP sign-in yields a session for that account, exposing data the victim then enters.

Better Auth 0.4.9 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an OAuth sign-in authentication flaw that treats unverified provider emails as verified, including string "false" email_verified claims, unchecked generic OAuth profile/ID-token subject mismatches, and ignored Zoom provider options. Attackers holding a victim's address unverified at an affected provider can sign in, link to the victim's local account, and obtain its session.

SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in its bucket storage layer on Windows, where ObjectKey::check_no_traversal splits object keys only on forward slashes while FileStore::to_os_path treats backslashes as directory separators. Attackers can supply object keys such as /..\bucket2\secret to bypass the traversal check and read or modify files in other buckets.

Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.8.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows attackers to hijack SSO identities by planting local accounts with unverified victim emails. When emailfallback is enabled, attackers register or edit a local account using the victim's email, causing the victim's first OIDC login to link into the attacker-controlled account and expose their data.

The Admin Columns plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'HTTP_USER_AGENT' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The kses sanitization pass in classes/Sanitize/Kses.php uses wp_kses_allowed_html('post') augmented with iframe[src] and the data: protocol; because wp_kses_attr_check accepts any data-* attribute on any allowed tag without inspecting its value, a payload embedded inside a data-ac-tip attribute survives intact and is subsequently assigned to innerHTML by assets/js/table.js, bypassing the apparent mitigation entirely.

Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Documents & Files renameFile() action that allows authenticated users with folder upload rights to move files outside adm_my_files by supplying ../ sequences in adm_new_name. Attackers can relocate an uploaded SVG containing script to the web root, where it is served inline and executes stored cross-site scripting against administrators for account takeover.

A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Banking Management System 1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file manage_handover.php. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

A vulnerability has been found in jprocms up to 1.7.7. Affected by this vulnerability is the function validateParam of the component Expression Language Handler. The manipulation leads to os command injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

A security vulnerability has been detected in itsourcecode Document Management System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file /edit.php. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains a heap based buffer overflow. An unauthenticated remote attacker with adjacent network access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a denial of service condition.

SurrealDB 3.0.4 before 4.0.0 does not apply operator-configured WebSocket frame, message, and buffer size limits to the GraphQL WebSocket upgrade handler at GET /graphql, falling back to permissive library defaults. Unauthenticated remote attackers who supply the target namespace and database in request headers can hold up to 64 MiB of in-flight data per concurrent connection, exhausting server memory and degrading availability.

A vulnerability was found in itsourcecode Banking Management System 1.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file manage_user.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in src/compositor/mpeg4_text.c that allows heap out-of-bounds reads by casting a Text node's fontStyle field to M_FontStyle unchecked. Attackers can craft an XMT/BIFS scene placing a smaller node like Face in fontStyle, causing build_text to read past the allocation and crash MP4Box.

Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a clickjacking vulnerability because src/hooks.server.ts never sets X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors headers on responses. Attackers on a same-site origin can embed the UI in an invisible iframe to trick authenticated users into stopping stacks, deleting resources, or changing settings.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in avi_parse_input_file() in src/media_tools/avilib.c that increments track counters before checking AVI_MAX_TRACKS. Attackers can supply a crafted AVI file declaring a ninth audio stream, causing AVI_audio_format and AVI_close() to access track[8] and crash the process.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by supplying a crafted XMT scene. Attackers can modify InputSensor, Layout or EnvironmentTest nodes during parsing, triggering compositor handlers that read uninitialized private stacks and cause denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() in src/scenegraph/commands.c that misinterprets single node values as child lists for MFNode field replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene that causes an invalid node pointer to be dereferenced by gf_node_register(), crashing MP4Box for denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_instantiate() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that lacks cycle detection or depth limits. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose PROTO body instantiates itself directly or indirectly, exhausting the stack and crashing MP4Box when imported.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory via stale object descriptor links. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene where xmt_node_end() frees a subtree containing InputSensor MFURL fields, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory and crash MP4Box.

The Restrictions for BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4 This is due to the plugin splicing the attacker-controlled request URI into a PHP expression inside a double-quoted string and evaluating it with eval(). Because PHP interpolates double-quoted strings, a payload of the form {${...}} in the URL path is executed during interpolation, so no quote breakout is required and WordPress' slashing does not mitigate it. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server with a single GET request. The affected conditions ship enabled by default and are evaluated before any logged-in check, so no plugin configuration is needed; the site must have BuddyPress and Paid Memberships Pro active alongside this plugin.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_discard_subtree() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to exhaust the call stack. Attackers can persuade a user to process a crafted XMT file with deeply nested discarded SFNode and MFNode fields to crash MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory when xmt_node_end() discards an out-of-scope node without resetting command-buffer state. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file that leaves parser->command_buffer and parser->command dangling, causing later parsing to access freed memory and crash MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that retains a pointer to a PROTO sub-graph freed by gf_sg_proto_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file imported with MP4Box, causing xmt_parse_command() to update the freed graph's referencing_commands list and crash the process.

The PublishPress Tag Groups: Stylish Displays For Your Tags and Categories plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'column_gap' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload bypasses wp_kses_post sanitization on save because it contains no HTML tags — only a double-quote character within shortcode attribute syntax that breaks out of the style attribute at render time.
vp: publishpress tag groups: stylish displays for your tags and categories

cves.d: Mailflare before 48957fb contains a host header injection vulnerability in the password-reset request handler that allows unauthenticated attackers to poison reset links when APP_URL is unset. Attackers can submit a reset request for a victim's email with a malicious Host header, capturing the single-use token when the victim clicks the link to take over the account.

A flaw has been found in Microweber up to 2.0.20. This impacts the function UserManager::make_logged of the file src/MicroweberPackages/App/Http/Controllers/ApiController.php of the component Generic API Dispatcher. This manipulation causes improper access controls. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 2.0.21 will fix this issue. Patch name: e639d26e61b989b100f8b6f6bb78c0cecca79b99. You should upgrade the affected component.

Members WordPress plugin before 3.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated visitors to read role-restricted posts by viewing Latest Posts blocks in full-content mode. The block renders raw post_content without firing the_content filter, bypassing members_content_permissions_protect() and exposing complete bodies of restricted posts.

The Everest Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Missing Authorization in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.4 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with everest_forms_create_forms capabilities, to activate any already-installed inactive plugin on the server by supplying an arbitrary slug, triggering its activation hooks and escalating privileges up to administrator level. Exploitation requires that a site administrator has delegated the everest_forms_create_forms capability to a lower-privileged role via the plugin's Role & Permission feature, and that at least one inactive installed plugin whose main file follows the slug/slug.php naming convention exists on the server.
vp: everest forms – contact form, payment form, quiz, survey & custom form builder with ai

cves.d: Casdoor before 4.27.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in decodeSamlMessage that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by sending unbounded DEFLATE-compressed SAML messages. Attackers can send a small, highly compressed SAMLRequest or SAMLResponse to the /api/saml/logout/:owner/:application endpoint, which inflates to gigabytes and crashes or stalls the server.

Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI HTTP/1 parser that buffers protocol lines without size limits. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send request lines, headers, chunk-size lines or trailers lacking CRLF to grow worker memory and consume CPU, causing denial of service.

msgpackr before 2.1.4 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote attackers to cause denial of service by repeatedly re-decoding buffered incomplete values. Attackers can stream a large container of small elements in small chunks to UnpackrStream or decodeIter, triggering quadratic decoding cost that blocks the Node.js event loop.

A vulnerability has been found in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file booking.php. Such manipulation of the argument venue_id leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

A security vulnerability has been detected in Open Asset Import Library Assimp up to 6.0.6. The impacted element is the function Assimp::JoinVerticesProcess::ProcessMesh of the file code/PostProcessing/JoinVerticesProcess.cpp of the component PostProcessing JoinVerticesProcess. Such manipulation leads to out-of-bounds write. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was found in DumbWareio DumbDrop up to ff8f813f493e89c7da056e7a3101ce2ef48e3960. Affected by this vulnerability is the function isPathWithinUploadDir of the file src/routes/files.js of the component Files API. The manipulation results in improper access controls. The attack may be launched remotely. This product operates on a rolling release basis, ensuring continuous delivery. Consequently, there are no version details for either affected or updated releases. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security flaw has been discovered in warpdesign pcx-js up to 1.1.1. Affected is the function decode8bpp/decode4bpp of the file js/pcx.js of the component PCX Pixel Buffer Decoder. Performing a manipulation results in uncontrolled memory allocation. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Cesanta Mongoose 7.22 before 7.24 with the built-in TLS stack contains an out-of-bounds read in mg_timegm() that allows remote attackers to crash the process via crafted X.509 certificate validity months. Attackers can present a certificate with month '00' or out-of-range values during the handshake, before signature verification, causing an unchecked dm array index and denial of service.

A flaw has been found in shaozilee bmp-js up to 0.1.0. This vulnerability affects the function BmpDecoder.parseRGBA of the file lib/decoder.js. This manipulation causes uncontrolled memory allocation. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A vulnerability was identified in Snes9x up to 1.63. The impacted element is the function S9xUnfreezeFromStream of the file snapshot.cpp of the component Save-State Screenshot Restoration. The manipulation leads to out-of-bounds read. The attack must be carried out locally. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A security vulnerability has been detected in SourceCodester Cosmetics and Beauty Product Online Store 1.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file admin/orders/view_order.php of the component Admin Order Management. The manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.
vp: cosmetics and beauty product online store

cves.d: PdfPig through 0.1.16 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying crafted PDF documents with self-referencing AcroForm /Kids or deeply nested marked content. Attackers can trigger an uncatchable StackOverflowException in AcroFormFactory.GetAcroField or Page.GetOptionalContentsRecursively, terminating any process reading form fields or optional content.

Formance Ledger 2.2.0-beta.3 before 2.4.18 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote API callers to execute SQL by supplying unvalidated account expand values. Attackers can inject comment-separated SQL through the expand query parameter or base64 pagination cursor to run queries with the ledger database role's privileges.

SurrealDB 1.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a capability check bypass in its embedded JavaScript scripting engine, where the surrealdb.functions bridge calls the internal fnc::synchronous() and fnc::asynchronous() dispatchers without enforcing function capability checks. Authenticated users denied access to built-in functions in SurrealQL can execute them by calling them through surrealdb.functions from embedded JavaScript.

OceanWP WordPress Theme before 4.2.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the oceanwp_edd_terms_list() function in inc/edd/edd-helpers.php, which allows authenticated users with EDD download category creation permissions to inject malicious JavaScript by crafting a category name that breaks out of an unescaped HTML title attribute. Attackers can create a category name containing an event-handler payload that executes in the browser of visitors who interact with the category link on the public EDD archive page, potentially compromising an administrator's session if they view the affected page while authenticated.

probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory buffering vulnerability in parseExif in lib/parse_stream/webp.js that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory via an attacker-declared EXIF chunk length. Attackers can supply a WebP stream or URL to probe(url) or probe(stream) declaring a huge EXIF length after VP8X, causing unbounded buffering and process memory exhaustion.

The CodePeople Post Map for Google Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'cpm_map[api_key]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The settings form nonce is itself rendered on the Subscriber-accessible page (reachable via a trailing-slash bypass of the slug guard), making nonce verification no real barrier to the unauthorized save.
vp: codepeople post map for google maps

cves.d: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows clients with table write access to persist writes refused by THROWing table events within interactive transactions. Attackers can run a guarded statement via RPC begin and query, ignore the returned error, and commit to persist the record and event side effects.

The MetForm – Contact Form, Survey, Quiz, Conditional Forms, Form Templates & Custom Form Builder for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mf-te (the form-builder-chosen name of the Text Editor field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires a published form containing a Text Editor block; the form's public markup exposes the submission nonce as data-form-nonce, allowing any unauthenticated visitor to satisfy the only submission barrier and store the malicious payload.
vp: metform – contact form, survey, quiz, conditional forms, form templates & custom form builder for elementor

cves.d: The Photo Gallery, Sliders, Proofing and Themes – NextGEN Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the site administrator to have configured the Thickbox lightbox effect with the "Try to apply to all images" context (thumbEffectContext=all_images), and exploitation additionally depends on an administrator approving the attacker's initial comment so that subsequent comments from that author are auto-approved.
vp: photo gallery, sliders, proofing and themes – nextgen gallery

cves.d: The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '_tutor_profile_bio' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected anchor payload uses a full-viewport invisible overlay (position:fixed; width:100vw; height:100vh; opacity:0) so that any click on the public profile page triggers the tutor-copy-text handler, which passes a browser-decoded data-text value to tutor_toast() where it is parsed as live HTML by jQuery.
vp: tutor lms – elearning and online course solution

cves.d: The Thim Kit for Elementor – Pre-built Templates & Widgets for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the Post Comment widget is used with the Text Reveal entrance animation (Elementor class 'ekit--fx-word-reveal') on a Single Post template, and the comment widget must be within the initial viewport; once the first comment by an attacker is approved, or if comment moderation is disabled, subsequent payloads fire automatically for every visitor who loads the affected page.
vp: thim kit for elementor – pre-built templates & widgets for elementor

cves.d: Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other users' private projects through the tasks.overdue webhook payload. Attackers can register a personal tasks.overdue webhook with one subscribed overdue task, then receive project titles, descriptions, and owner IDs from other users' reminders at external URLs.

The PublishPress Revisions: Duplicate Posts, Submit, Approve and Schedule Content Changes plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.4 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to permanently force-delete arbitrary trashed posts, pages, and revisions owned by any user, including higher-privileged users. The required nonce is trivially harvested by any Contributor-level user because the static 'revisions-deleted' nonce action is emitted in a redirect header on the init hook before WordPress enforces edit.php's capability check, and once obtained it authorizes deletion of any trashed post or revision on the site.
vp: publishpress revisions: duplicate posts, submit, approve and schedule content changes

cves.d: The ProfilePress – Paid Membership, Online Courses (LMS), Ecommerce, User Registration & Login Form, User Profile & Restrict Content plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 4.18.0 via the 'sortby<form_id>, filter<form_id>' parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract reconstruct any listed member's full e-mail address one character at a time via a boolean LIKE oracle, and enumerate users holding arbitrary usermeta keys such as ppress_billing_phone. The e-mail address oracle is reachable on any default install that used the plugin's 'Create pages' onboarding notice, because pp_email_address is enabled as a search field by default and the resulting directory page is published with no capability or nonce gate.
vp: profilepress – paid membership, online courses (lms), ecommerce, user registration & login form, user profile & restrict content

cves.d: The WP Job Portal – AI-Powered Recruitment System for Company or Job Board website plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based SQL Injection via the 'columns[<attacker-chosen key>]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.0 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.
vp: wp job portal – ai-powered recruitment system for company or job board website

A vulnerability was identified in kanishka-linux reminiscence 0.3 on Windows. This issue affects the function convert_html_pdf_with_chromium of the file pages/dbaccess.py of the component Chromium HTML-to-PDF Conversion Pipeline. Such manipulation of the argument url_name leads to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

The Stream – Activity Log & Audit Trail plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.4.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable on sites with 50 or fewer total users, as above that threshold the user filter uses an AJAX endpoint that returns entity-encoded labels and is not affected.

Hysteria from 2.0.0 before 2.9.2 contains an ACL bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clients to reach blocked UDP destinations by reusing an established UDP session. Attackers can open a session to an allowed destination, then send later packets to localhost or private-network addresses to access internal-only UDP services.

Frappe ERPNext 16.0.0 before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Manufacturing module endpoint that allows authenticated users to cancel Stock Reservation Entries without record-level write permission. Low-privilege attackers can send crafted requests naming manufacturing documents of other companies or outside their User Permissions to release reserved stock and disrupt stock allocation.

Weblate before 2026.11 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the reset_password view that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset victim passwords by abusing case-insensitive Unicode e-mail matching. Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password.

Frappe ERPNext 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns the parsed content of private import-format files without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their permitted scope to read those private files.

Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that returns item valuation rates without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to retrieve their valuation rates.

Umami 3.3.0 before 3.5.0 contains a race condition in two-factor authentication attempt limiting that allows attackers holding a user's password to bypass lockout. Attackers can send many concurrent POST requests to /api/2fa/verify that pass checkRateLimit before recordFailedAttempt runs, brute-forcing TOTP or backup codes beyond the five-attempt limit.

Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Selling module endpoint that returns Loyalty Program terms without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other customers' Loyalty Program terms.

web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.10, 4.0.x before 4.0.7, and 4.1.x before 4.1.7 contain a padding oracle in RSACrypt::decryptWithRSA15() because RSA1_5 decryption lacks implicit rejection, so invalid padding, wrong CEK length, and valid padding take measurably different time. Remote attackers can submit adaptively crafted JWE encrypted_key values and measure these timing differences to recover the wrapped content encryption key.

Frappe ERPNext 8.0.0 before 15.123.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that allows authenticated users to read restricted warehouse data. Attackers with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming warehouses excluded by their User Permissions to obtain stock quantities and stock values.

Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI parser that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to desynchronize request framing by sending malformed framing headers. Attackers can send whitespace-padded Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length headers, signed Content-Length values, or invalid chunk terminators to smuggle requests past front-end proxies to the ASGI application.

Frappe ERPNext 11.0.0-beta before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains an authorization flaw in the customer portal Issue list, which scopes records differently from the detail view and skips permission checks on requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users without roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other customers' Issues.

Frappe ERPNext 7.0.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the customer portal Projects list, which returns every field without checking permission on the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read project costing and margin data.

diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in Notifier#invite that allows authenticated users to inject HTML or markdown into invitation emails through unescaped profile names. Attackers can set profile first or last names containing raw HTML, links, or images so invitation emails sent from the pod render spoofed content in recipients' mail clients.

Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that reconciles Bank Transactions against caller-named vouchers, checking permission only on the Bank Transaction and not on each voucher. Authenticated users with the Accounts User role who can edit a Bank Transaction can send crafted requests naming vouchers outside their permitted scope to change the reconciliation state of vouchers belonging to other companies or outside their User Permissions.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated adjacent network attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution. This vulnerability is considered critical as it may allow unauthenticated command execution.

Frappe ERPNext 14.0.0 before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Utilities module endpoint that lets any authenticated user retry failed bulk transactions without a role check. Attackers, including portal users with no roles, can send crafted requests for a chosen date to mark site-wide failed bulk transactions as retried, removing them from the normal recovery path, and add background job load.

Frappe ERPNext 7.1.0 before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Projects module endpoints that return Timesheet data without restricting results to records the caller may read. Any authenticated user, including one with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests to read organisation-wide Timesheet work and billing details.

Vikunja from 0.16.0 before 2.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that writes users' Trello API tokens to application logs and Sentry by formatting provider errors verbatim in listeners.go. When a Trello migration fails with a transport error, the URL error embeds the token query parameter, letting anyone with log or telemetry access obtain the reusable third-party credential.

Frappe ERPNext 14.47.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Accounts module where a method on accounting vouchers creates and submits Repost Accounting Ledger documents with permission checks skipped. Authenticated users with read access to a Sales Invoice, Purchase Invoice, Payment Entry, Journal Entry, or Purchase Receipt can call it to delete and repost that voucher's General Ledger entries, an action restricted to System Managers.

Frappe ERPNext 12.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module dashboard chart source that returns account balance history without checking chart or account permissions. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no roles, can send crafted requests naming any account to read general ledger balance history of any company.

Frappe ERPNext 15.55.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns a company's Chart of Accounts without checking whether the caller may read the requested records. Authenticated users, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read any company's Chart of Accounts.

A flaw has been found in jprocms up to 1.7.7. Affected is the function StrUtil.format of the component Database Backup Module. Executing a manipulation of the argument host/port/username/password/dbName can lead to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Frappe ERPNext 15.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing validation vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint that fails to verify reserved item rows belong to the target Sales Order. Authenticated users with the Stock User role can send crafted reservation requests naming another order's item row to reserve stock beyond that order's limits, creating mismatched Stock Reservation Entries.

A flaw was found in gpgme. When processing crafted input, an early return following memory reallocation can leave internal buffer pointers referencing previously freed memory, resulting in a double-free condition during cleanup. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to corrupt process memory, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution or a Denial of Service (DoS) crash.

pypdf before 7.0.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to cause large memory usage by supplying crafted PDF cross-reference streams. Attackers can craft a PDF whose cross-reference stream offsets all point to one large object, exhausting memory in applications parsing the file.

Coder 2.6.0 before 2.29.21, 2.30.0 before 2.34.10, 2.35.0 before 2.35.8, 2.36.0 before 2.36.5, and 2.37.0 before 2.37.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the workspace agent dRPC API, whose handlers dereference unset request sub-messages and unconfigured Tailnet providers without recovering from panics. Attackers holding a workspace agent token can send UpdateLifecycle, UpdateStartup, or BatchUpdateMetadata messages lacking sub-messages, or call RefreshResumeToken or WorkspaceUpdates, to repeatedly crash coderd.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability. An unauthenticated remote attacker with adjacent network access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a denial of service condition.

VoidAuth before 1.19.2 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to evade stricter ProxyAuth domain rules by sending percent-encoded path separators. Attackers can request paths with encoded slashes, backslashes, semicolons, or dot segments that match a broader rule, reaching restricted paths once the reverse proxy or backend decodes them.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an Argument Injection vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and unauthorized access to filesystem resources.

actix-http 3.0.0 before 3.20.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust memory by sending large-window brotli request bodies. Attackers can send an 850-byte body with Content-Encoding: br declaring a 2^30 window, forcing about 1 GiB of decoder allocation per request and OOM-killing servers.

Electerm before 5.9.0 on Windows contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute PowerShell code via crafted file or folder names containing Unicode quote characters. Attackers can deliver names containing U+2019 through archives, WSL distributions, or SMB shares, which break out of getFolderSizeWin() and calcLocal() quoting when victims request folder sizes, executing code as the electerm user.

rclone 1.67.0 before 1.76.0 contains a credential leak vulnerability in the Ulozto backend that sends X-Auth-Token and X-User-Token headers to unintended hosts on HTTP redirect because downloads use the authenticated f.rest client instead of f.cdn. Attackers who can observe or redirect CDN download traffic can capture the long-lived API key and session token to gain persistent access to the victim's Ulozto storage.

rclone from 1.59.0 before 1.76.0 contains a confinement escape in the local backend's setXattr function that lets attackers write user.* extended attributes outside the destination root via a planted symlink. Attackers who plant a symlink to an outside directory with a pre-existing child can use --links --metadata operations to set attacker-chosen user.* xattrs on files outside the destination.

LibRaw through 0.22.3 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in LibRaw::pentax_4shot_load_raw() that allows attackers to crash applications by scanning tiff_ifd[] beyond its 10 entries. Attackers can supply a crafted four-frame Pentax DNG with too few IFDs matching the raw dimensions to cause denial of service when LIBRAW_RAWOPTIONS_PENTAX_PS_ALLFRAMES is enabled.

ArcadeDB 26.3.1 before 26.11.1 contains a read-only bypass vulnerability that allows server administrators to commit writes through the MCP read-only query tool by submitting Groovy-fallback Gremlin scripts. GremlinQueryEngine.analyze() evaluates scripts like Graph API addVertex calls on the auto or groovy engine and classifies them as READ, persisting writes the read-only restriction should refuse.

msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3.0.0 through cpp-9.0.0, when built with MSGPACK_USE_X3_PARSE, contains an out-of-bounds heap read in x3_parse.hpp due to assuming contiguous input. Attackers can supply msgpack str, bin or ext values unpacked from non-contiguous containers like std::deque, causing memcpy past storage blocks and disclosing adjacent heap memory.

better-auth 1.5.5 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the organization plugin, where the creator role check compares the raw invitation role string while later checks trim it. Admins or other non-creator roles that can invite can submit a padded role such as " owner" that becomes owner on acceptance, allowing deletion of the organization and removal of original owners.

In mcp-server-fetch from 2026.10.10 and before 2026.11.11, the check that blocks requests to non-public addresses treats IPv6 site-local addresses (fec0::/10) as public. A fetch to such an address passes the server-side request forgery guard. Practical impact is limited because many hosts have no route to this range.

In mcp-server-git before 2026.10.28, the --repository restriction can be bypassed through a nested directory that contains a .git file with a gitdir pointer to a repository outside the allowed path. A caller who can invoke the server's tools, place such a file in the allowed tree, and knows the outside repository's path can read committed content from that repository and create branches in it.

Better Auth (better-auth, @better-auth/kysely-adapter, and @better-auth/drizzle-adapter) before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains a race condition with MySQL or MariaDB serial IDs because the inserted row's ID is read via a separate LAST_INSERT_ID() query that may run on a different pooled connection. Under concurrent load, a user signing in can receive another user's session and act as that user.

A flaw was found in the file-pcx plugin in GIMP, affecting 32-bit builds only. When processing a PCX image file, the plugin calculates memory allocation sizes based on the image dimensions and the number of color planes. If the fstab entry also sets X-mount.owner, X-mount.group, or X-mount.mode, root then changes ownership or mode on that redirected inode.

The nsenter --join-cgroup option opens the target cgroup.procs file as root and leaves that file descriptor open across later namespace and credential changes and across execve(). Because the kernel checks later cgroup migrations using the credentials from the original open, a program run in an attacker-controlled target can inherit root's ability to move host processes between cgroups. After a privileged operator uses --join-cgroup against that target, an unprivileged user can migrate and terminate unrelated root processes.

A privilege escalation flaw was found in the scan_mysql actor of leapp-upgrade-el9toel10 (provided by leapp-repository). During RHEL 9 to RHEL 10 upgrades, the actor runs:
mysqld --validate-config --log-error-verbosity=2 directly as root in the Leapp actor context, bypassing the packaged MySQL systemd unit that normally starts the daemon as User=mysql.

A process compromised as the mysql OS identity can write a version-2 persisted configuration (mysqld-auto.cnf) and a malicious shared object into /var/lib/mysql (a directory owned by mysql). That persisted map can set plugin_dir to /var/lib/mysql and early_plugin_load (or related loader options such as plugin_load / plugin_load_add) so MySQL loads the attacker-controlled object during configuration validation. Plugin loading can reach dlopen() before MySQL’s runtime-user check and before plugin-symbol validation.

When an administrator subsequently runs the documented Leapp preupgrade or upgrade workflow, attacker-controlled code can execute as UID 0 with a full capability set in an unconfined SELinux domain (unconfined_t). The attack does not require write access to the default system plugin path under /usr; redirecting plugin_dir via mysql-owned persisted state is sufficient. Ordinary SQL privileges alone (including highly privileged SQL accounts) are not a sufficient startpoint — OS-level execution as the mysql service identity is required, plus later administrator invocation of Leapp.
