items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Client for NFS allows unauthenticated network RCE. Cross-platform file sharing clients remain high-value targets for remote attackers.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 Windows Client for NFS 栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行（RCE）。跨平台文件共享客户端仍是远程攻击者的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Partition Management Driver enables unauthenticated network RCE. Storage layer driver vulnerabilities can compromise disk operations and system integrity remotely.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 Windows Partition Management Driver 堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可启用未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行（RCE）。存储层驱动漏洞可在远程破坏磁盘操作与系统完整性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 null pointer dereference in Windows Kerberos causes network denial of service. While lower severity, it disrupts critical authentication infrastructure and can be chained with other exploits.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5 的 Windows Kerberos 空指针解引用漏洞可导致网络拒绝服务（DoS）。尽管严重性较低，但会破坏关键认证基础设施，且可与其他漏洞利用链式组合。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 Kerberos authentication bypass allows unauthorized network elevation of privilege, critically undermining enterprise identity and access control infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8 Kerberos 身份验证绕过漏洞允许未经授权的网络提权，严重破坏企业身份与访问控制基础设施。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting enables unauthenticated remote code execution, providing a high-value initial access vector for attackers.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8 Windows Error Reporting 堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，为攻击者提供高价值的初始访问向量。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Remote Desktop Client heap overflow permits remote code execution over a network, directly compromising interactive session security and enabling lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 Remote Desktop Client 堆溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接破坏交互式会话安全性并支持横向移动。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Credential Providers heap overflow allows remote code execution, potentially facilitating mass credential harvesting and bypassing Windows login security mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 Credential Providers 堆溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，可能助长大规模凭证窃取并绕过 Windows 登录安全机制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 iSCSI heap overflow enables remote code execution, threatening storage infrastructure and allowing persistent backdoor deployment in networked environments.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 iSCSI 堆溢出漏洞可启用远程代码执行，威胁存储基础设施，并允许在网络环境中持久化部署后门。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Windows PowerShell enables unauthenticated remote code execution. Given PowerShell's ubiquitous role in system administration and scripting, this poses a severe exploitation risk across enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows PowerShell 整数下溢漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。鉴于 PowerShell 在系统管理和脚本编写中的普遍作用，此漏洞在企业环境中构成严重的利用风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Compressed Folder component allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Frequent user interaction with archive files makes this a high-value target for phishing and drive-by attacks.
items.reason_zh: Compressed Folder 组件堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。用户频繁与归档文件交互，使其成为网络钓鱼和挂马攻击的高价值目标。

items.reason_en: NTFS heap overflow permits unauthenticated remote code execution directly against the core filesystem driver. Compromising NTFS effectively breaks OS-level isolation and grants full system control.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 堆溢出漏洞允许针对核心文件系统驱动程序直接进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。攻破 NTFS 实质上破坏了操作系统级隔离并授予完全系统控制权。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code allows unauthenticated remote code execution. This directly threatens developer workstations, CI/CD agents, and introduces supply chain contamination risks.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 缺少授权检查允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。这直接威胁开发者工作站、CI/CD 代理，并引入供应链污染风险。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in Windows Update enables local privilege escalation. Attackers can manipulate DLL loading during updates to gain SYSTEM-level access, undermining trust in the patching mechanism.
items.reason_zh: Windows Update 不受信任的搜索路径漏洞可启用本地提权。攻击者可操纵更新期间的 DLL 加载过程以获取 SYSTEM 级权限，破坏对补丁机制的信任。

items.reason_en: High-severity remote code execution flaw in Windows Microsoft DirectMusic allows unauthenticated attackers to compromise endpoints without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Windows Microsoft DirectMusic 高危远程代码执行漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者在无需用户交互的情况下攻陷终端。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Windows Credential Guard enables local attackers to bypass hardware-backed protections and impersonate identities for sensitive operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows Credential Guard 缺失身份验证机制允许本地攻击者绕过基于硬件的保护措施，冒充身份执行敏感操作。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in the Windows Advanced Rasterization Platform facilitates local privilege escalation, potentially granting full system control to compromised users.
items.reason_zh: Windows Advanced Rasterization Platform 内存损坏漏洞可促成本地提权，可能赋予被攻陷用户完全系统控制权。

items.reason_en: An integer underflow in the UxTheme library enables remote code execution over a network, representing an extreme threat to client workstations due to its high CVSS score and broad attack surface.
items.reason_zh: UxTheme 库整数下溢漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，因其高 CVSS 评分和广泛的攻击面，对客户工作站构成极端威胁。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Remote Desktop Services allows network-triggered code execution, directly compromising administrative access and enabling full system takeover.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Services 堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许触发网络代码执行，直接破坏管理访问权限并支持完全接管系统。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in Print Spooler Components facilitates network-based privilege escalation, continuing the pattern of historically exploited print subsystem vulnerabilities.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler Components 释放后使用（UAF）漏洞可促进基于网络的提权，延续了历史上打印子系统漏洞被频繁利用的模式。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds read in HTTP.sys permits local code execution via crafted requests, maintaining the risk profile of legacy web stack memory corruption flaws.
items.reason_zh: HTTP.sys 越界读取漏洞允许通过构造请求实现本地代码执行，延续了传统 Web 栈内存损坏漏洞的风险特征。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Rich Text Edit Control allows unauthorized remote code execution. This critical flaw in a widely used component enables attackers to execute arbitrary code via malicious documents.
items.reason_zh: Windows Rich Text Edit Control 堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的远程代码执行。这一广泛使用组件中的关键缺陷使攻击者能够通过恶意文档执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Windows Hyper-V allows authorized local privilege escalation. This vulnerability compromises virtualization isolation and could allow breakout attacks from guest environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 不受信任的指针解引用漏洞允许已授权用户进行本地提权。该漏洞破坏了虚拟化隔离，可能导致从客户机环境逃逸的攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation allows unauthorized remote code execution. Attackers can exploit this by processing specially crafted media files to run arbitrary code on the host system.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的远程代码执行。攻击者可通过处理特制的媒体文件在此漏洞上实施利用，从而在主机系统上运行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Microsoft Edge allows authorized local privilege escalation. Highlights persistent browser engine vulnerabilities that require immediate patching to prevent local system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge 竞态条件漏洞允许已授权用户进行本地提权。凸显了浏览器引擎中持续存在的漏洞，需立即修补以防止本地系统被攻陷。

items.reason_en: Critical 9.8 CVSS heap overflow in Libarchive enables remote code execution without authentication, posing a severe threat to Windows clients.
items.reason_zh: Libarchive 关键 9.8 CVSS 堆溢出漏洞允许无需身份验证的远程代码执行，对 Windows 客户端构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible path traversal in Print Spooler allows unauthenticated attackers to escalate privileges remotely, impacting widespread enterprise deployments.
items.reason_zh: Print Spooler 网络可访问的路径遍历漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者远程提权，影响广泛的企业部署。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the TCP/IP stack permits remote code execution by unauthenticated attackers, directly compromising core network functionality.
items.reason_zh: TCP/IP 协议栈释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者进行远程代码执行，直接破坏核心网络功能。

items.reason_en: Numeric truncation error in Microsoft Word enables remote code execution via malicious documents, a highly effective phishing vector.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Word 数值截断错误漏洞允许通过恶意文档实现远程代码执行，是一种高度有效的网络钓鱼向量。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Excel allows remote code execution through crafted files, frequently targeted in document-based attacks.
items.reason_zh: Excel 释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许通过特制文件实现远程代码执行，在基于文档的攻击中常被作为目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Media Foundation allows remote code execution without authentication, posing a severe threat to media processing workflows.
items.reason_zh: Media Foundation中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许无需身份验证的远程代码执行，对媒体处理工作流构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Color Management enables remote code execution, compromising display rendering and system stability across Windows endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Color Management中的整数溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏Windows终端上的显示渲染和系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Visual Studio Code permits unauthorized file access and remote code execution, directly endangering developer workstations and CI agents.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的路径遍历漏洞允许未经授权的文件访问和远程代码执行，直接危及开发人员工作站和CI代理。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Virtual Filtering Platform allows remote code execution, impacting network stack and graphics virtualization layers.
items.reason_zh: Virtual Filtering Platform中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，影响网络协议栈和图形虚拟化层。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the Windows PDF parser facilitates remote code execution via malicious documents, maintaining a high exploitation success rate.
items.reason_zh: Windows PDF解析器中的越界写入漏洞可通过恶意文档实现远程代码执行，并保持较高的利用成功率。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows Codecs Library enables network RCE across major Windows releases, impacting a vast installed base.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library中的整数溢出漏洞可在各大Windows版本中启用网络远程代码执行(RCE)，影响庞大的已安装基数。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Color Management allows unauthorized network code execution with a critical 9.8 CVSS score.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Color Management中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经授权的远程网络代码执行，CVSS评分达9.8（危急）。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in LSASS facilitates local privilege escalation, directly threatening credential security and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: LSASS中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可促成本地权限提升，直接威胁凭据安全和横向移动防御。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Windows Task Scheduler enables local privilege escalation through widely used scheduled automation workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Task Scheduler中的命令注入漏洞可通过广泛使用的计划任务自动化工作流实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in HID Parser Library allows network privilege escalation, significantly expanding the attack surface for peripheral-dependent systems.
items.reason_zh: HID Parser Library中的整数下溢漏洞允许网络权限提升，显著扩大了依赖外围设备系统的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Windows Advanced Rasterization Platform enables local privilege escalation via graphics processing routines frequently targeted by exploits.
items.reason_zh: Windows Advanced Rasterization Platform中的类型混淆漏洞可通过常被漏洞利用程序针对的图形处理例程实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Player permits network code execution from malicious media files, remaining a persistent threat in enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Player中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许从恶意媒体文件执行网络代码执行，在企业环境中仍是持续存在的威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Imaging Component allows network code execution triggered by crafted images, commonly delivered via phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Windows Imaging Component中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可由精心构造的图像触发网络代码执行，通常通过钓鱼活动投递。

items.reason_en: A double free vulnerability in Windows DirectMusic allows remote code execution with a CVSS score of 9.8. This critical flaw enables attackers to compromise Windows endpoints by exploiting network-accessible multimedia components.
items.reason_zh: Windows DirectMusic中的双重释放漏洞CVSS评分为9.8，可导致远程代码执行。该危急缺陷使攻击者能够通过利用网络可访问的多媒体组件来入侵Windows终端。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Raw Image Extension permits remote code execution (CVSS 8.8). It poses a significant risk as Windows clients frequently process untrusted image files in everyday workflows.
items.reason_zh: Raw Image Extension中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行(CVSS 8.8)。由于Windows客户端在日常工作流中频繁处理不受信任的图像文件，该漏洞构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows NFS Client enables remote code execution over a network (CVSS 8.8). This vulnerability directly threatens enterprise file-sharing environments relying on cross-platform protocols.
items.reason_zh: Windows NFS Client中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码执行(CVSS 8.8)。该漏洞直接威胁依赖跨平台协议的企业文件共享环境。

items.reason_en: Bypasses AMD secure boot authentication via flawed cryptographic signature verification in the PSP Boot ROM, enabling unsigned code execution at full processor privilege levels.
items.reason_zh: 通过PSP Boot ROM中缺陷的加密签名验证绕过AMD安全启动认证，从而以完整的处理器特权级别执行未签名代码。

items.reason_en: Allows privilege escalation in the HP Hotkey UWP Service, potentially granting attackers higher system rights on affected workstations.
items.reason_zh: HP Hotkey UWP Service中存在权限提升漏洞，可能使攻击者在受影响的工作站上获得更高的系统权限。

items.reason_en: Exploits a length verification flaw in WebKitGTK's DMA-BUF path, allowing compromised processes to corrupt memory and potentially execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: 利用WebKitGTK的DMA-BUF路径中的长度验证缺陷，使被攻陷的进程能够破坏内存并可能执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in OpenShot allows arbitrary code execution when users open malicious .osp project files via unrestricted pickle.load() calls.
items.reason_zh: OpenShot中存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，当用户通过无限制的pickle.load()调用打开恶意的.osp项目文件时，可导致任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Electerm executes PowerShell commands via crafted Unicode filenames delivered through archives, WSL, or SMB shares, enabling remote command injection on Windows hosts.
items.reason_zh: Electerm通过档案、WSL或SMB共享传递的精心构造的Unicode文件名执行PowerShell命令，从而在Windows主机上实现远程命令注入。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation occurs because restricted bind mounts do not pin source paths, allowing unprivileged users to redirect SUID mount(8) to arbitrary host directories.
items.reason_zh: 发生本地权限提升是因为受限的绑定挂载未固定源路径，允许非特权用户将SUID mount(8)重定向到任意主机目录。

items.reason_en: A local attacker can bypass libinput security restrictions by placing crafted Lua bytecode in configuration directories, executing unauthorized scripts with elevated program permissions.
items.reason_zh: 本地攻击者可通过在配置目录中放置精心构造的Lua字节码来绕过libinput的安全限制，以提升的程序权限执行未授权脚本。

items.reason_en: Cockpit's remote login feature passes unsanitized hostnames to the SSH client, enabling remote attackers to inject malicious SSH options and achieve command execution via the web interface.
items.reason_zh: Cockpit的远程登录功能将未过滤的主机名传递给SSH客户端，使远程攻击者能够注入恶意的SSH选项并通过Web界面实现命令执行。

items.reason_en: GDM's CreateRemoteDisplay method lacks proper authorization checks, allowing local attackers to bypass automatic login verification and initiate unauthorized remote display sessions.
items.reason_zh: GDM的CreateRemoteDisplay方法缺乏适当的授权检查，允许本地攻击者绕过自动登录验证并启动未授权的远程显示会话。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in Mutter's Wayland color-management path can be triggered by malicious clients to corrupt compositor memory, potentially leading to crashes or code execution.
items.reason_zh: Mutter的Wayland颜色管理路径中存在释放后使用缺陷，恶意客户端可触发该缺陷以破坏合成器内存，可能导致崩溃或代码执行。

items.reason_en: GIMP's DDS file parser allocates an undersized heap buffer when processing crafted pixel formats, enabling remote attackers to trigger arbitrary code execution by tricking users into opening malicious images.
items.reason_zh: GIMP的DDS文件解析器在处理精心构造的像素格式时会分配过小的堆缓冲区，使远程攻击者能够通过诱骗用户打开恶意图像来触发任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: The GIMP XMC plugin fails to validate comment subtypes before array indexing, causing out-of-bounds memory access and use-after-free conditions that can lead to application crashes or exploitation.
items.reason_zh: GIMP的XMC插件在数组索引前未验证注释子类型，导致越界内存访问和释放后使用条件，可能引发应用程序崩溃或被利用。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in X.Org/Xwayland allows local attackers to corrupt display server memory, potentially leading to privilege escalation or system instability.
items.reason_zh: X.Org/Xwayland中的越界写入漏洞允许本地攻击者破坏显示服务器内存，可能导致权限提升或系统不稳定。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Emacs enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands via crafted URLs, directly compromising desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: Emacs中的命令注入漏洞使远程攻击者能够通过精心构造的URL执行任意Shell命令，直接破坏桌面环境。

items.reason_en: Flawed authorization in ZoneAlarm Client Agent allows low-privilege users to escalate to SYSTEM privileges, severely weakening endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: ZoneAlarm Client Agent 中的授权缺陷允许低权限用户提升至 SYSTEM 权限，严重削弱端点安全性。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary script execution in GNOME Yelp help app risks user data exfiltration when processing malicious documentation.
items.reason_zh: GNOME Yelp 帮助应用在处理恶意文档时存在任意脚本执行风险，可能导致用户数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files via improper argument neutralization in the Synology DSM OAuth API, posing a critical risk to desktop-class NAS deployments.
items.reason_zh: 通过 Synology DSM OAuth API 中的参数净化不当，允许远程攻击者读取或写入任意文件，对桌面级 NAS 部署构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Fixes invalid dma_fence_ops persistence during GPU device unbind, preventing potential driver crashes or privilege escalation in desktop graphics stacks.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 GPU 设备解绑期间无效的 dma_fence_ops 持久化问题，防止桌面图形栈中潜在的驱动程序崩溃或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Prevents kernel panic by safely managing framebuffer mode list rebuilding, ensuring display stability for legacy and modern desktop GPUs.
items.reason_zh: 通过安全地管理帧缓冲模式列表重建防止内核恐慌，确保传统与现代桌面 GPU 的显示稳定性。

items.reason_en: Resolves duplicate dependency fence releases in the AMDGPU scheduler, avoiding reference count corruption that could destabilize desktop rendering pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 解决了 AMDGPU 调度器中重复释放依赖栅栏的问题，避免引用计数损坏导致桌面渲染管线不稳定。

items.reason_en: Path traversal during Flatpak app deployment enables malicious packages to overwrite or symlink critical host system files like /etc/passwd, bypassing desktop sandboxing protections.
items.reason_zh: Flatpak 应用部署过程中的路径遍历漏洞使恶意软件包能够覆盖或符号链接 /etc/passwd 等关键主机系统文件，从而绕过桌面沙箱保护。

items.reason_en: Unbounded busy loops in GNOME Remote Desktop's VNC TLS handlers allow unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust CPU resources and cause a denial of service on desktop systems.
items.reason_zh: GNOME Remote Desktop 的 VNC TLS 处理器中存在无界忙等待循环，允许未认证的远程攻击者耗尽 CPU 资源并导致桌面系统拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Edge for iOS permits unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly impacting mobile browser security and user data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge for iOS 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许未经认证的远程代码执行，直接影响移动浏览器安全性和用户数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams for Android exposes mobile users to credential theft and account takeover via malicious links.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams for Android 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞使移动用户面临凭据窃取和账户接管风险，攻击者可利用恶意链接实施攻击。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Edge on mobile platforms allows remote attackers to execute code through malicious web pages.
items.reason_zh: 移动平台上的 Microsoft Edge 存在释放后使用漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过恶意网页执行代码。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android enables network-based spoofing attacks. This directly compromises mobile collaboration tools and undermines user authentication trust.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams for Android 中的代码注入漏洞支持基于网络的欺骗攻击，直接破坏移动协作工具的安全性并削弱用户认证信任机制。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android allows unauthorized code execution, risking corporate data stored within the mobile client.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams for Android 中的路径遍历漏洞允许未经授权执行代码，危及移动客户端内存储的企业数据。

items.reason_en: Origin validation errors in Teams for Android weaken security boundaries, enabling phishing and man-in-the-middle attacks against mobile communications.
items.reason_zh: Teams for Android 中的源验证错误削弱了安全边界，使针对移动通信的网络钓鱼和中间人攻击成为可能。

items.reason_en: A remote Bluetooth stack buffer overflow allows denial of service or potential code execution when nearby devices send specially crafted Extended Inquiry Response packets during discovery.
items.reason_zh: 远程蓝牙协议栈缓冲区溢出漏洞在发现过程中，当附近设备发送特制的扩展查询响应数据包时，可导致拒绝服务或潜在代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing receive buffer validation in Zephyr RTOS SMBUS handlers allows crafted device interactions to trigger out-of-bounds reads on embedded systems.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr RTOS SMBUS 处理器中缺少接收缓冲区验证，允许构造的设备交互触发嵌入式系统的越界读取。

items.reason_en: Exposes an insecure direct object reference in the DreameHome cloud API, allowing authenticated users to hijack other users' smart home devices.
items.reason_zh: DreameHome 云 API 暴露了不安全直接对象引用漏洞，允许已认证用户劫持其他用户的智能家居设备。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Kerberos-io cameras allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator JWT tokens using a hardcoded fallback key, granting full device control.
items.reason_zh: Kerberos-io 摄像头存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未认证攻击者使用硬编码的回退密钥伪造管理员 JWT 令牌，从而获取设备的完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on an exposed IFM interface allows unauthenticated remote attackers to send arbitrary commands, forcing device reboots or uploading malicious firmware.
items.reason_zh: 暴露的 IFM 接口缺少身份验证，允许未认证的远程攻击者发送任意命令，强制设备重启或上传恶意固件。

items.reason_en: Komodo's Periphery agent defaults to failing open when core_public_keys and passkeys are empty, permitting unauthenticated attackers to connect as trusted cores and compromise edge devices.
items.reason_zh: 当 core_public_keys 和 passkeys 为空时，Komodo 的 Periphery 代理默认采用失败开放策略，允许未认证攻击者以受信任核心身份连接并攻陷边缘设备。

items.reason_en: pappl-retrofit fails to sanitize filenames during PostScript Printer Description uploads, enabling unauthenticated attackers to perform directory traversal and manipulate restricted printer configuration files.
items.reason_zh: pappl-retrofit 在上传 PostScript Printer Description 时未能清理文件名，使未认证攻击者能够执行目录遍历并篡改受限的打印机配置文件。

items.reason_en: mcp-server-kubernetes accepts dash-prefixed values as positional operands, allowing remote MCP clients to inject arbitrary kubectl flags and execute unintended cluster commands.
items.reason_zh: mcp-server-kubernetes 将带短横线前缀的值接受为位置操作数，允许远程 MCP 客户端注入任意 kubectl 标志并执行非预期的集群命令。

items.reason_en: erxes insurance_api plugin trusts caller-supplied identifiers in GraphQL mutations, allowing unauthenticated attackers to create, overwrite, or delete sensitive contract templates.
items.reason_zh: erxes insurance_api 插件信任 GraphQL 变更操作中调用方提供的标识符，允许未认证攻击者创建、覆盖或删除敏感合同模板。

items.reason_en: Remote OS command injection in TOTOLINK router CGI handler allows unauthenticated attackers to fully compromise home network devices and gain root access.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK 路由器 CGI 处理器中存在远程操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许未认证攻击者完全攻陷家庭网络设备并获取 root 权限。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in HPE wireless management interface enables remote code execution, jeopardizing wireless infrastructure security.
items.reason_zh: HPE 无线管理界面存在身份验证绕过漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，危及无线网络基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: Drops invalid CAN XL frames bypassing the CAN framework via PF_PACKET, preventing driver crashes in automotive and IoT network interfaces.
items.reason_zh: 丢弃通过 PF_PACKET 绕过 CAN 框架的无效 CAN XL 帧，防止汽车和物联网网络接口中的驱动程序崩溃。

items.reason_en: Fixes use-after-free in HackRF SDR device URB allocation error paths, securing software-defined radio hardware commonly used in IoT prototyping.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 HackRF SDR 设备 URB 分配错误路径中的释放后使用漏洞，保障常用于物联网原型设计的软件定义无线电硬件安全。

items.reason_en: Prevents double free during USB video capture buffer allocation, protecting embedded camera and streaming IoT components from memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: 防止 USB 视频捕获缓冲区分配期间的双重释放问题，保护嵌入式摄像头和流媒体物联网组件免受内存损坏影响。

items.reason_en: Enforces minimum buffer sizes for audio URB transfers, preventing heap corruption in connected USB audio peripherals and smart devices.
items.reason_zh: 强制执行音频 URB 传输的最小缓冲区大小，防止连接的 USB 音频外设和智能设备发生堆损坏。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in the WatchYourLAN IoT network scanner's Web API permits attackers to redirect requests to internal network resources and extract sensitive configuration data.
items.reason_zh: WatchYourLAN IoT 网络扫描器的 Web API 中存在服务器端请求伪造漏洞，允许攻击者将请求重定向至内部网络资源并提取敏感配置数据。

items.reason_en: SQL LIKE pattern injection in Project Quay's robot account listing allows attackers to enumerate and decrypt sensitive registry credentials, compromising container supply chain security.
items.reason_zh: Project Quay 的机器人账户列表存在 SQL LIKE 模式注入漏洞，攻击者可借此枚举并解密敏感的镜像仓库凭据，破坏容器供应链安全。

items.reason_en: Authenticated members can trigger arbitrary rm -rf commands via unquoted path interpolation in Dokploy's file mount operations, risking complete host filesystem destruction.
items.reason_zh: 经身份验证的用户可通过 Dokploy 文件挂载操作中未加引号的路径插值触发任意 rm -rf 命令，面临主机文件系统被彻底摧毁的风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication on critical Azure App Service functions enables unauthenticated remote code execution, severely undermining cloud hosting isolation and tenant security.
items.reason_zh: Azure App Service 关键功能缺失身份验证机制，可引发未授权远程代码执行，严重破坏云托管隔离性与租户安全。

items.reason_en: Windows Hyper-V contains a use-after-free flaw allowing local privilege escalation. This undermines hypervisor isolation, which is foundational for cloud virtualization and multi-tenant environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 存在释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。该漏洞破坏了超管理器隔离机制，进而危及云虚拟化和多租户环境的安全基础。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in the Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver enables local privilege escalation. Weak container security boundaries directly threaten cloud-native application deployments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver 存在访问控制不当漏洞，可导致本地权限提升。容器安全边界薄弱直接威胁云原生应用的部署安全。

items.reason_en: Azure CycleCloud suffers from OS command injection allowing local code execution. This exposes cloud orchestration management interfaces to potential compromise by authenticated users.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，可导致本地代码执行。该漏洞使云编排管理接口面临被已认证用户攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass by spoofing in Microsoft Fabric grants unauthorized privilege escalation over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric 存在通过欺骗绕过身份验证的漏洞，可在网络层面实现未授权的权限提升。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure AD B2C allows attackers to elevate privileges using user-controlled cryptographic keys.
items.reason_zh: Azure AD B2C 存在授权绕过漏洞，攻击者可利用用户可控的加密密钥提升权限。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Azure Portal enables account spoofing and session hijacking for cloud administrators.
items.reason_zh: Azure Portal 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可导致云管理员账户伪造与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured permissions in M365 Copilot expose sensitive organizational data to authorized users within the tenant.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 权限配置不当，导致敏感组织数据向租户内已授权用户泄露。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure AI Language allows complete privilege escalation over the network, directly compromising cloud AI service endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Language 缺失身份验证机制，可导致网络层面的完全权限提升，直接危及云 AI 服务端点安全。

items.reason_en: Improper channel restriction in Azure Key Vault enables attackers to manipulate communications and escalate privileges to access sensitive cryptographic secrets.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault 存在通道限制不当漏洞，攻击者可借此篡改通信内容并提升权限，从而窃取敏感加密密钥。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure CLI allows remote code execution through malicious inputs, threatening cloud infrastructure management and automation workflows.
items.reason_zh: Azure CLI 存在命令注入漏洞，攻击者可通过恶意输入实现远程代码执行，威胁云基础设施管理与自动化工作流安全。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in MSAL enables account spoofing and unauthorized access to cloud identity and token services.
items.reason_zh: MSAL 存在通过捕获重放绕过身份验证的漏洞，可导致账户伪造及对云身份与令牌服务的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Spring Cloud Azure suffers from improper authentication, allowing unauthorized network actors to escalate privileges and compromise cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Spring Cloud Azure 存在身份验证不当漏洞，允许未经授权的网络实体提升权限并攻陷云工作负载。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dynamics 365 enables remote code execution, exposing sensitive enterprise cloud applications to exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 存在不可信数据反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，使敏感的企业级云应用面临被利用风险。

items.reason_en: Critical stack overflow in Hyper-V enables hypervisor escape and remote code execution, threatening underlying cloud infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 存在严重的栈溢出漏洞，可导致超管理器逃逸及远程代码执行，威胁底层云基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Hyper-V allows local privilege escalation within virtualized environments, risking host compromise.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 存在越界读取漏洞，可在虚拟化环境中实现本地权限提升，危及宿主机安全。

items.reason_en: Information disclosure in Azure Attestation compromises device health verification, undermining zero-trust cloud onboarding.
items.reason_zh: Azure Attestation 存在信息泄露漏洞，破坏了设备健康验证机制，进而削弱零信任云环境的接入安全。

items.reason_en: Active Directory Domain Services denial of service impacts enterprise identity infrastructure and cloud authentication reliability.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 存在拒绝服务漏洞，影响企业身份基础设施及云身份验证的可靠性。

items.reason_en: AD FS resource exhaustion vulnerability threatens single sign-on availability, disrupting cloud application access.
items.reason_zh: AD FS 存在资源耗尽漏洞，威胁单点登录（SSO）服务的可用性，导致云应用访问中断。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible information disclosure in Azure Attestation and Device Health services undermines cloud identity verification and secure boot trust chains.
items.reason_zh: Azure Attestation 与 Device Health 服务存在网络可访问的信息泄露漏洞，破坏了云身份验证及安全启动信任链。

items.reason_en: High-severity 8.2 CVSS default cryptographic key usage in AWS SSM Agent allows non-administrative local users to extract sensitive host management configurations, weakening cloud instance security.
items.reason_zh: AWS SSM Agent 因高严重性（CVSS 8.2）的默认加密密钥使用问题，允许非管理员本地用户提取敏感的主机管理配置，削弱云实例安全性。

items.reason_en: Complete authentication failure in Azure Event Grid allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, risking full tenant compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure Event Grid 存在身份验证完全失效漏洞，允许网络层面的未授权权限提升，面临整个租户被攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in M365 Copilot enables network-based privilege escalation, threatening AI-assisted enterprise workflows.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 存在授权不当漏洞，可实现基于网络的权限提升，威胁人工智能辅助的企业工作流安全。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Machine Learning allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges, exposing internal cloud infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure Machine Learning 存在服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，允许已认证的攻击者提升权限，从而暴露内部云基础设施。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in the Azure Portal enables network-based spoofing attacks, potentially leading to session hijacking and administrative abuse.
items.reason_zh: Azure Portal 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可支持基于网络的欺骗攻击，可能导致会话劫持与管理权限滥用。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via spoofing in Azure DevTest Labs allows unauthorized network access, undermining isolated development environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevTest Labs 存在通过欺骗绕过身份验证的漏洞，允许未授权的网络访问，破坏隔离开发环境的安全性。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Azure Site Recovery permits network-based privilege escalation, jeopardizing disaster recovery operations.
items.reason_zh: Azure Site Recovery 存在访问控制不当漏洞，允许基于网络的权限提升，危及灾难恢复操作的正常进行。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass through user-controlled keys in Microsoft Clarity enables network privilege escalation, compromising analytics data.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Clarity 存在通过用户可控密钥绕过授权的漏洞，可实现网络权限提升，导致分析数据泄露或遭篡改。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure AI Foundry allows unauthorized information disclosure over the network, exposing sensitive model data.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Foundry 中缺失的授权机制允许通过网络进行未授权的信息披露，导致敏感模型数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Azure Machine Learning permits network-based information disclosure, risking proprietary AI asset exposure.
items.reason_zh: Azure Machine Learning 中的错误授权机制允许基于网络的信息披露，可能导致专有 AI 资产暴露。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Exchange Server enables network-based privilege escalation, directly impacting corporate communication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的弱认证机制允许基于网络的权限提升，直接影响企业通信基础设施。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure Pipelines allows unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary commands over the network, potentially compromising CI/CD workflows and deployed artifacts.
items.reason_zh: Azure Pipelines 中的命令注入漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络执行任意命令，可能破坏 CI/CD 工作流及已部署的工件。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Azure Arc permits network privilege escalation, potentially allowing attackers to compromise entire hybrid cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中的错误授权机制允许网络权限提升，可能使攻击者能够破坏整个混合云环境。

items.reason_en: Misresolved name/reference in Azure Arc enables network privilege escalation, undermining the foundational trust model of cloud management planes.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc 中的名称/引用解析错误可导致网络权限提升，破坏云管理平面的基础信任模型。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra allows network RCE, directly compromising managed database workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra 中的参数注入漏洞允许网络远程代码执行，直接破坏托管数据库工作负载。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Azure Virtual Machines enables network privilege escalation, facilitating lateral movement and unauthorized resource access within cloud tenants.
items.reason_zh: Azure Virtual Machines 中的 SSRF 漏洞可导致网络权限提升，促进云租户内部的网络横向移动和未授权资源访问。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Microsoft Copilot in Azure allows network information disclosure, exposing sensitive data through integrated AI services.
items.reason_zh: Azure 中 Microsoft Copilot 的 SSRF 漏洞允许网络信息披露，通过集成的 AI 服务暴露敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication flaw in Azure SQL Database allows unauthenticated remote attackers to escalate privileges and compromise sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 中的关键认证缺陷允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者提升权限并破坏敏感数据。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure Kubernetes Service enables unauthorized users to gain elevated control over container workloads and cluster resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中的授权绕过漏洞使未授权用户能够获取对容器工作负载和集群资源的更高控制权。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in the Azure SRE Agent grants attackers full administrative access to cloud management infrastructure over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure SRE Agent 中缺失的授权机制允许攻击者通过网络获得对云管理基础设施的完全管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Entra Connect Sync allows privilege escalation over the network, jeopardizing hybrid identity synchronization between on-premises Active Directory and cloud tenants.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra Connect Sync 中的错误授权机制允许通过网络提升权限，危及本地 Active Directory 与云租户之间的混合身份同步。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in SharePoint enables remote code execution, creating a direct attack vector against cloud-hosted document management systems.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不安全反序列化漏洞可启用远程代码执行，为基于云的文档管理系统创建了直接的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Critical deserialization flaw in SharePoint allows remote code execution, highlighting systemic risks in Microsoft's cloud collaboration stack.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的关键反序列化缺陷允许远程代码执行，凸显了 Microsoft 云协作栈中的系统性风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Remote Desktop Gateway Service allows remote code execution, exposing virtual desktop infrastructure to network attacks.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service 中的释放后使用漏洞可启用远程代码执行，使虚拟桌面基础设施面临网络攻击风险。

items.reason_en: Spoofing vulnerability in Netlogon undermines domain trust relationships, enabling lateral movement in hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
items.reason_zh: Netlogon 中的欺骗漏洞破坏了域信任关系，使得在混合云和本地环境中实现横向移动成为可能。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Azure Kubernetes Service allows local privilege escalation, risking container breakout and cluster compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service 中的不当权限管理允许本地权限提升，可能导致容器逃逸及集群被破坏。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure HDInsights enables network privilege escalation, endangering managed big data processing workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsights 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许网络权限提升，危及托管的大数据处理工作负载。

items.reason_en: Sensitive information exposure in Azure HDInsight allows network data leakage, violating cloud data confidentiality standards.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsight 中的敏感信息泄露漏洞允许网络数据外泄，违反云数据保密标准。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Entra Device Registration allows unauthorized network privilege escalation. Compromising this identity component threatens entire cloud tenant architectures.
items.reason_zh: Entra Device Registration 中的授权绕过漏洞允许未授权的网络权限提升。该身份组件一旦被破坏，将威胁整个云租户架构。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Microsoft Dynamics 365 permits authorized attackers to execute code over the network. This poses significant risks to enterprise SaaS deployments and business logic integrity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dynamics 365 中的代码注入漏洞允许具备权限的攻击者通过网络执行代码。这对企业 SaaS 部署和业务逻辑完整性构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure Confidential Clean Rooms allows network tampering by authorized users. Data isolation guarantees in secure cloud workloads are directly undermined.
items.reason_zh: Azure Confidential Clean Rooms 中缺失的授权机制允许已授权用户进行网络篡改。安全云工作负载中的数据隔离保障直接受到破坏。

items.reason_en: Insufficiently protected credentials in Azure CycleCloud enable network information disclosure. Attackers can extract sensitive cluster configurations and authentication tokens.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中凭证保护不足可导致网络信息披露。攻击者可提取敏感的集群配置和认证令牌。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure OpenAI allows unauthorized users to escalate privileges remotely, risking sensitive AI model and tenant data.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 中缺失的身份验证机制允许未授权用户远程提权，危及敏感的 AI 模型和租户数据。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Graph enables privilege escalation across enterprise APIs, potentially granting attackers broad administrative access.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Graph 中的错误授权机制可在企业 API 间引发权限提升，可能赋予攻击者广泛的管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in Azure NFS mount helper allows local privilege escalation, undermining secure cloud storage integration.
items.reason_zh: Azure NFS mount helper 中的不受信任搜索路径漏洞允许本地权限提升，破坏安全的云存储集成。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud allows network-based privilege escalation, potentially granting attackers control over cloud workloads and orchestration layers.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中缺失的授权机制允许基于网络的权限提升，可能赋予攻击者对云工作负载和编排层的控制权。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Azure Storage Explorer can be chained to achieve network-based privilege escalation and facilitate data exfiltration from cloud storage accounts.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Explorer 中的跨站脚本漏洞可通过链式利用实现网络权限提升，并促进从云存储账户中窃取数据。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in Dynamics 365 grants unauthenticated remote code execution, risking complete compromise of business-critical SaaS workloads.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics 365 中的不安全反序列化漏洞可授予未经身份验证的远程代码执行权限，危及关键业务 SaaS 工作负载的完整安全性。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Power BI enables remote code execution, threatening tenant data isolation and analytics platform integrity.
items.reason_zh: Power BI 中的输入验证不当可导致远程代码执行，威胁租户数据隔离与分析平台完整性。

items.reason_en: Information disclosure in Azure Attestation exposes sensitive device health metadata, potentially undermining zero-trust verification mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Azure Attestation 中的信息泄露会暴露敏感的设备健康元数据，可能破坏零信任验证机制。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Managed Grafana allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network. Its critical CVSS 9.8 score indicates severe risk to cloud-managed analytics and monitoring services.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Grafana 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许未经授权的网络权限提升。其关键的 CVSS 9.8 评分表明对云托管分析与监控服务构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in Azure Front Door enables unauthorized privilege escalation across the network. This misconfiguration directly impacts cloud edge security and load balancing reliability.
items.reason_zh: Azure Front Door 中的权限分配错误可导致未经授权的网络权限提升。此配置错误直接影响云边缘安全与负载均衡可靠性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Azure CycleCloud allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally. It poses operational risks to cloud-based high-performance computing workload orchestration.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证攻击者在本地提升权限。该漏洞对基于云的高性能计算工作负载编排构成运营风险。

items.reason_en: Command injection in the Azure Monitor Agent allows privilege escalation over the network. Compromising monitoring agents exposes telemetry pipelines, configuration secrets, and adjacent cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Monitor Agent 中的命令注入漏洞允许通过网络提升权限。监控代理被攻陷将导致遥测管道、配置密钥及相邻云工作负载暴露。

items.reason_en: Critical deserialization flaw in Microsoft Entra ID permits unauthenticated remote code execution, posing a severe risk to cloud tenant identity management.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中的关键反序列化缺陷允许未经认证的远程代码执行，对云租户身份管理构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure Active Directory allows attackers to pivot through internal metadata services and escalate privileges across cloud infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞使攻击者能够通过内部元数据服务进行横向移动，并在云基础设施中提升权限。

items.reason_en: Deserialization vulnerability in Azure Service Bus carries a high exploitation probability and enables remote code execution in cloud-native messaging architectures.
items.reason_zh: Azure Service Bus 中的反序列化漏洞具有较高的利用概率，可在云原生消息架构中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure AI Foundry allows unauthorized remote privilege escalation. This represents a severe identity and access management failure in a core cloud platform.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Foundry 中关键功能缺少身份验证会导致未经授权的网络权限提升。这代表了核心云平台在身份与访问管理方面的严重失效。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Azure Logic Apps allows unauthorized remote privilege escalation. Could lead to complete compromise of automated workflows and interconnected cloud resources.
items.reason_zh: Azure Logic Apps 中的访问控制不当允许未经授权的网络权限提升。可能导致自动化工作流及互联云资源被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass using an alternate channel in Microsoft Entra ID allows unauthorized remote privilege escalation. Directly impacts enterprise identity infrastructure and single sign-on capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中通过备用通道绕过身份验证可导致未经授权的网络权限提升。直接影响企业身份基础设施与单点登录能力。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass through user-controlled keys in Microsoft Container Registry allows unauthorized remote privilege escalation. Exposes container orchestration pipelines to supply chain and lateral movement attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Container Registry 中通过用户可控密钥绕过授权可导致未经授权的网络权限提升。使容器编排管道面临供应链攻击与横向移动风险。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Azure CycleCloud exposes sensitive information to unauthenticated network attackers, risking cloud infrastructure compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中的路径遍历漏洞使未认证的网络攻击者能够获取敏感信息，危及云基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in SharePoint enables remote code execution over the network, threatening hybrid and cloud-deployed enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的路径遍历漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，威胁混合部署与云部署的企业环境。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in VM Inspector for Azure enables remote code execution, breaking hypervisor isolation and compromising host security.
items.reason_zh: Azure VM Inspector 中的链接解析不当可导致远程代码执行，破坏 Hypervisor 隔离并危及主机安全。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening container orchestration clusters.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service 中缺少身份验证可导致未经认证的远程代码执行，威胁容器编排集群。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in AAD App Proxy bypasses identity gateway controls, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution and tenant compromise.
items.reason_zh: AAD App Proxy 中的身份验证不当绕过了身份网关控制，导致未经认证的远程代码执行及租户被攻陷。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure Pipelines permits remote code execution within build environments, risking supply chain integrity and credential theft.
items.reason_zh: Azure Pipelines 中的命令注入漏洞允许在构建环境中执行远程代码，危及供应链完整性并可能导致凭证窃取。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure AI Foundry allows authenticated attackers to probe internal networks and escalate privileges via cloud AI services.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Foundry 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许已认证攻击者探测内部网络，并通过云 AI 服务提升权限。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure DevOps Server enables network privilege escalation, risking cloud pipeline integrity and unauthorized deployment actions.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevOps Server 中的授权绕过漏洞可导致网络权限提升，危及云管道完整性并引发未授权的部署操作。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Azure DevOps allows remote code execution (CVSS 9.9). Compromising this service jeopardizes entire CI/CD pipelines and sensitive source code repositories.
items.reason_zh: Azure DevOps 中的身份验证不当可导致远程代码执行（CVSS 9.9）。该服务被攻陷将危及整个 CI/CD 管道及敏感源代码仓库。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Incus container platform allows attackers to impersonate trusted certificates (CVSS 10). This grants immediate cluster-level control over containerized workloads and orchestration layers.
items.reason_zh: Incus 容器平台中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许攻击者伪造受信任证书（CVSS 10）。这将赋予其对容器化工作负载及编排层的即时集群级控制权。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud enables remote code execution (CVSS 8.4). Attackers can hijack managed high-performance computing clusters to execute arbitrary commands on underlying hosts.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞可导致远程代码执行（CVSS 8.4）。攻击者可劫管托管的高性能计算集群，在底层主机上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Flawed REST cookie parsing in Xen Orchestra converts authentication tokens into empty objects, completely bypassing authentication for virtualization management.
items.reason_zh: Xen Orchestra 中 REST Cookie 解析缺陷会将身份验证令牌转换为空对象，从而完全绕过虚拟化管理的身份验证。

items.reason_en: Fails to filter reserved environment variables like PATH during Docker Compose deploys, enabling authenticated users to inject malicious binaries and achieve remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Docker Compose 部署期间未过滤 PATH 等保留环境变量，导致已认证用户可注入恶意二进制文件并实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Omits the authentication method from the cache key in Rclone's SFTP proxy, allowing attackers to reuse cached credentials and bypass authentication.
items.reason_zh: Rclone 的 SFTP 代理在缓存键中遗漏了身份验证方法，导致攻击者可重用缓存凭据并绕过身份验证。

items.reason_en: Accepts attacker-controlled tenant IDs in a public initialization endpoint, breaking multi-tenant isolation and allowing cross-tenant database evaluation.
items.reason_zh: 公共初始化端点接受攻击者控制的租户 ID，破坏了多租户隔离性，并允许跨租户数据库查询。

items.reason_en: CRI-O checkpoint restore failures allow restored containers to retain original credentials, capabilities, and seccomp states, completely bypassing Kubernetes security contexts.
items.reason_zh: CRI-O 检查点恢复失败会导致恢复后的容器保留原始凭据、能力及 seccomp 状态，从而完全绕过 Kubernetes 安全上下文。

items.reason_en: Container escape to host root privileges occurs when crun runs rootful containers with passt networking, executing unvalidated payloads directly from the container image.
items.reason_zh: 当 crun 使用 passt 网络运行以 root 权限的容器时，会发生逃逸至主机 root 权限的情况，直接执行来自容器镜像的未验证载荷。

items.reason_en: Privileged QEMU guests can bypass chipset D_LCK protection by positioning a writable RAM alias over locked SMRAM, injecting malicious code into protected firmware regions.
items.reason_zh: 特权 QEMU 客户机可通过将可写 RAM 别名映射至锁定的 SMRAM 区域，绕过芯片组 D_LCK 保护，进而向受保护的固件区域注入恶意代码。

items.reason_en: Portainer's WebSocket attach and exec endpoints suffer from authorization bypass, allowing standard users to access and execute commands inside other users' containers using leaked environment variables.
items.reason_zh: Portainer 的 WebSocket attach 与 exec 端点存在权限绕过缺陷，攻击者可利用泄露的环境变量以普通用户身份访问并执行其他用户容器内的命令。

items.reason_en: gvproxy's unauthenticated /services/forwarder/expose endpoint does not validate socket paths, enabling attackers to delete arbitrary files on the host system running gvisor-tap-vsock.
items.reason_zh: gvproxy 的未授权 /services/forwarder/expose 端点未对 socket 路径进行校验，导致攻击者可删除运行 gvisor-tap-vsock 的主机系统上的任意文件。

items.reason_en: crun exhibits a TOCTOU vulnerability when copying files onto tmpfs mounts with tmpcopyup, allowing shared writable volumes to redirect image files onto host directories during container creation.
items.reason_zh: crun 在使用 tmpcopyup 机制将文件复制至 tmpfs 挂载点时存在 TOCTOU 竞争条件漏洞，致使共享可写卷可在容器创建过程中将镜像文件重定向至主机目录。

items.reason_en: spice-server truncates size_t allocation sizes to int during GLZ dictionary restoration, allowing malicious authenticated SPICE clients to trigger massive heap buffer overflows during VM live migration.
items.reason_zh: spice-server 在恢复 GLZ 字典时将 size_t 类型的分配大小截断为 int，使得经过认证的恶意 SPICE 客户端可在虚拟机热迁移期间触发大规模的堆缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Multiple spice-server migration handlers rely on client-supplied offsets without bounds validation, enabling authenticated SPICE clients to read arbitrary heap memory or corrupt heap structures.
items.reason_zh: spice-server 的多个迁移处理程序直接使用客户端传入的偏移量而缺乏边界校验，导致已认证的 SPICE 客户端可读取任意堆内存或篡改堆结构。

items.reason_en: Critical command injection via unsanitized NetBIOS names in Samba allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on Active Directory controllers.
items.reason_zh: Samba 中未过滤的 NetBIOS 名称会引发严重的命令注入漏洞，使远程攻击者能够在 Active Directory 控制器上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Buildah cache mount path traversal breaks container isolation by allowing arbitrary host directory reads/writes during image builds.
items.reason_zh: Buildah 的缓存挂载路径遍历漏洞破坏了容器隔离机制，允许在镜像构建过程中任意读取或写入主机目录。

items.reason_en: cri-o directory traversal flaw enables containers to create symlinks to host files, granting unauthorized filesystem access beyond container boundaries.
items.reason_zh: cri-o 的目录遍历漏洞允许容器创建指向主机文件的符号链接，从而突破容器边界获取未授权的文件系统访问权限。

items.reason_en: Nested expression compiler bypass in Cribl allows read-only users to execute code with leader service account privileges, impacting log aggregation platforms.
items.reason_zh: Cribl 中存在嵌套表达式编译器绕过漏洞，允许只读用户以主服务账户权限执行代码，对日志聚合平台造成严重影响。

items.reason_en: kube-compare incorrectly executes untrusted container entrypoints, enabling remote code execution on operator workstations during cluster comparisons.
items.reason_zh: kube-compare 会错误执行不受信任的容器入口点，导致在集群比对期间可在运维人员工作站上触发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Implements bounds checking on shared ring buffer indices in CoCo VMs where the host is untrusted, preventing guest memory disclosure or escape.
items.reason_zh: 针对主机不可信的 CoCo VM，对共享环形缓冲区索引实施边界检查，以防止客户机内存泄露或逃逸。

items.reason_en: Triggers new ASID allocation on physical CPU switch to maintain address space isolation between co-located virtual machines in cloud hypervisors.
items.reason_zh: 在物理 CPU 切换时触发新的 ASID 分配，以保障云超管环境中共驻虚拟机的地址空间隔离。

items.reason_en: Unconditionally resets MMU context during emulated INIT instructions, mitigating state confusion attacks in nested virtualization environments.
items.reason_zh: 在模拟 INIT 指令时无条件重置 MMU 上下文，以缓解嵌套虚拟化环境中的状态混淆攻击。

items.reason_en: Ensures proper device reset before virtqueue deletion on probe failure, maintaining hardware state isolation in cloud-based IOMMU implementations.
items.reason_zh: 在设备探测失败时，确保在删除 virtqueue 前正确执行设备重置，以维持基于云环境的 IOMMU 硬件状态隔离。

items.reason_en: Double-fetching guest descriptors in DPDK's vhost-crypto module allows out-of-bounds host access, enabling potential full host compromise in virtualized cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: DPDK 的 vhost-crypto 模块中存在客户机描述符双重获取漏洞，可导致越界主机内存访问，在虚拟化云环境中可能引发完整的主机沦陷。

items.reason_en: Flawed enforcement of unconfined user namespace restrictions in AppArmor allows container escape, directly breaking isolation boundaries for cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: AppArmor 对用户命名空间限制的强制执行存在缺陷，可导致容器逃逸，直接破坏云工作负载的隔离边界。

items.reason_en: Incorrect INVVPID emulation on the wrong physical CPU in KVM nested virtualization can trigger hypervisor instability or enable nested VM escape attacks.
items.reason_zh: 在 KVM 嵌套虚拟化环境中，于错误的物理 CPU 上错误模拟 INVVPID 指令可能导致超管不稳定，或助长嵌套虚拟机逃逸攻击。

items.reason_en: Persistent cookie misuse in Cisco Expressway's database service allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands as root, actively exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: Cisco Expressway 数据库服务中持久化 Cookie 被滥用，允许未认证的远程攻击者以 root 权限执行任意操作系统命令，该漏洞已在实际环境中遭活跃利用。

items.reason_en: Remote stack buffer overflow in DrayTek Vigor2960's CGI processing module can be triggered via crafted HTTP requests, with known exploits available for router compromise.
items.reason_zh: DrayTek Vigor2960 的 CGI 处理模块存在远程栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过构造的 HTTP 请求触发，目前已有公开利用代码可导致路由器被控。

items.reason_en: The Network Policy Server (NPS) contains a critical heap overflow enabling network RCE. As a core authentication and access control service, its compromise disrupts network security enforcement.
items.reason_zh: 网络策略服务器（NPS）存在关键堆溢出漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行。作为核心身份认证与访问控制服务，其被攻破将严重破坏网络安全策略执行。

items.reason_en: Windows Schannel suffers from an out-of-bounds write allowing network RCE. This compromises the foundational TLS/crypto stack utilized across virtually all network devices and servers.
items.reason_zh: Windows Schannel 存在越界写入漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行。该漏洞将破坏底层 TLS/密码学栈，而该栈几乎被所有网络设备和服务器所依赖。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds read in the Windows IKE Extension permits network information disclosure. This weakens VPN and IPSec tunnel security, potentially exposing sensitive routing and encryption parameters.
items.reason_zh: Windows IKE 扩展存在越界读取漏洞，可导致网络信息泄露。该漏洞将削弱 VPN 与 IPSec 隧道安全性，可能暴露敏感的路由配置与加密参数。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DHCP Server enables unauthenticated remote code execution on critical network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 存在释放后使用漏洞，可导致在未认证情况下于关键网络基础设施上执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in DNS Server allows remote code execution targeting core name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 存在非受信指针解引用漏洞，可导致针对核心域名解析服务的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Resource leak in SMB Server triggers denial of service conditions across network shares, disrupting file access.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server 存在资源泄漏漏洞，将在网络共享层面引发拒绝服务状况，导致文件访问中断。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in NDES permits unauthorized network device enrollment and potential remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: NDES 的身份验证机制薄弱，允许未经授权的设备注册及潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows RRAS compromises routing and remote access services, facilitating network pivoting and lateral movement across segments.
items.reason_zh: Windows RRAS 存在远程代码执行漏洞，将破坏路由与远程访问服务，助长跨网段的数据包转发与横向移动。

items.reason_en: A double free vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution, disrupting IP address management and enabling widespread network attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 存在双重释放漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，破坏 IP 地址管理并引发大规模网络攻击。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Active Directory Domain Services allows remote code execution, fundamentally undermining directory authentication and trust relationships.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 存在授权逻辑缺陷，可导致远程代码执行，从根本上破坏目录身份认证与信任关系。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Reliable Multicast Transport Driver permits remote code execution, affecting critical network communication and multicast routing protocols.
items.reason_zh: 可靠多播传输驱动程序中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，影响关键网络通信与多播路由协议。

items.reason_en: Critical remote code execution in RRAS compromises network routing infrastructure, allowing unauthorized perimeter traversal.
items.reason_zh: RRAS 中的严重远程代码执行漏洞会破坏网络路由基础设施，使攻击者能够未经授权地穿越网络边界。

items.reason_en: RRAS remote code execution poses severe risks to network segmentation and firewall enforcement capabilities.
items.reason_zh: RRAS 的远程代码执行漏洞对网络分段和防火墙策略执行能力构成严重风险。

items.reason_en: Another RRAS RCE highlights systemic weaknesses in Windows routing services that require immediate network-level mitigation.
items.reason_zh: 另一起 RRAS 远程代码执行事件凸显了 Windows 路由服务的系统性缺陷，亟需实施网络级缓解措施。

items.reason_en: DHCP server stack overflow enables remote code execution targeting network provisioning and IP allocation services.
items.reason_zh: DHCP 服务器栈溢出漏洞可实现针对网络配置与 IP 分配服务的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: IKE extension spoofing vulnerability undermines secure VPN tunnel establishment, exposing traffic interception risks.
items.reason_zh: IKE 扩展欺骗漏洞破坏了安全 VPN 隧道的建立过程，增加了流量被拦截的风险。

items.reason_en: Critical network-based RCE in the DHCP Server allows unauthenticated attackers to seize control of network address management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DHCP 服务器中严重的基于网络的远程代码执行漏洞允许未认证攻击者接管网络地址管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in Windows DNS enables attackers to poison resolutions or compromise core network resolution services without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的远程代码执行漏洞使攻击者能够在无需凭据的情况下污染解析结果或破坏核心网络解析服务。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the HTTP Print Provider exposes legacy print services to unauthenticated remote exploitation, frequently targeted in ransomware deployment chains.
items.reason_zh: HTTP 打印提供程序中的堆溢出漏洞使传统打印服务面临未认证的远程利用风险，该漏洞常被用于勒索软件的部署链中。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server facilitates network-wide remote code execution, disrupting critical IP allocation services.
items.reason_zh: DHCP 服务器中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致全网范围的远程代码执行，破坏关键的 IP 分配服务。

items.reason_en: Network policy server vulnerability allows remote code execution, potentially bypassing AAA authentication frameworks and granting unauthorized network access.
items.reason_zh: 网络策略服务器漏洞可导致远程代码执行，可能绕过 AAA 认证框架并授予未经授权的访问权限。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server enables network-based remote code execution, disrupting critical IP address management.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP 服务器中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现基于网络的远程代码执行，破坏关键的 IP 地址管理功能。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in HTTP.sys allows network privilege escalation, affecting web server and proxy functionality across Windows deployments.
items.reason_zh: HTTP.sys 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致网络提权，影响跨 Windows 部署的 Web 服务器与代理功能。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in Windows iSCSI enables network privilege escalation, threatening storage area network configurations.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的错误链路解析漏洞可导致网络提权，威胁存储区域网络（SAN）的配置安全。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Network Device Enrollment Service causes network denial of service, blocking secure device onboarding.
items.reason_zh: 网络设备注册服务中的越界读取漏洞会导致网络拒绝服务，阻碍安全设备的接入流程。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Windows DNS permits network spoofing attacks, compromising name resolution reliability and security.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的源验证错误漏洞允许网络欺骗攻击，损害名称解析的可靠性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server permits remote code execution, threatening network infrastructure by allowing attackers to control critical IP assignment services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP 服务器中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，使攻击者能够控制关键的 IP 分配服务，从而威胁网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Network Policy Server exposes sensitive information over the network, potentially undermining network access control and authentication policies.
items.reason_zh: 网络策略服务器中的越界读取漏洞会在网络上暴露敏感信息，可能破坏网络访问控制与认证策略。

items.reason_en: Observable timing discrepancy in Schannel enables network RCE, exploiting cryptographic protocol implementations for covert attacks.
items.reason_zh: Schannel 中可观测的时序差异漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，攻击者可利用加密协议实现进行隐蔽攻击。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in the Windows DHCP Server causes network DoS, disrupting critical IP address allocation services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP 服务器中的越界读取漏洞会导致网络 DoS，破坏关键的 IP 地址分配服务。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows LDAP triggers network DoS, impairing directory service availability and authentication lookups.
items.reason_zh: Windows LDAP 中的越界读取漏洞会触发网络 DoS，降低目录服务可用性及身份验证查询效率。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in BranchCache results in network DoS, affecting content caching efficiency and overall network performance.
items.reason_zh: BranchCache 中的越界读取漏洞会导致网络 DoS，影响内容缓存效率及整体网络性能。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows TCP/IP allows local privilege escalation, indicating potential instability in core network stack operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 中的竞争条件漏洞可导致本地提权，表明核心网络栈操作存在潜在的不稳定性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows DHCP server allows remote attackers to execute code, potentially destabilizing critical network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP 服务器中的整数溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者执行代码，可能破坏关键网络基础设施的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows iSCSI service enables denial of service and potential privilege escalation over storage area networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 服务中的堆溢出漏洞可导致拒绝服务及在存储区域网络上的潜在提权。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting permits remote code execution triggered by network-accessible error reporting mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows 错误报告中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过网络可访问的错误报告机制触发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Distributed File System (DFS) enables network-based code execution, disrupting shared network resources, replication services, and branch office data access.
items.reason_zh: Windows 分布式文件系统（DFS）中的堆溢出漏洞可实现基于网络的代码执行，破坏共享网络资源、复制服务及分支机构数据访问。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows iSCSI Target Service allows remote code execution by unauthorized attackers, threatening storage area network (SAN) connectivity and block-level storage delivery.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 目标服务中的堆溢出漏洞允许未授权攻击者执行远程代码，威胁存储区域网络（SAN）连接性与块级存储交付。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Secure Socket Tunneling Protocol (SSTP) permits remote code execution over the network, compromising secure VPN tunnel endpoints and remote workforce access.
items.reason_zh: Windows 安全套接字隧道协议（SSTP）中的释放后使用漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行，破坏安全 VPN 隧道端点及远程办公访问。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference in iSCSI Target Service causes denial of service over the network, impacting reliable storage provisioning and causing operational downtime for connected clients.
items.reason_zh: iSCSI 目标服务中的空指针解引用漏洞会导致网络拒绝服务，影响可靠的存储供给，并导致已连接客户端出现业务中断。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in the DNS Server component allows remote code execution, threatening foundational network resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 组件中的类型混淆漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁基础网络解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in WebDAV enables remote privilege escalation, compromising file-sharing protocols commonly used across enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中的堆溢出漏洞可实现远程权限提升，破坏企业网络中广泛使用的文件共享协议。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client allows remote code execution, endangering remote administration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及远程管理流程。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Windows TCP/IP stack allows local privilege escalation, potentially destabilizing core network communications.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中的释放后使用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，可能破坏核心网络通信的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion flaw in OpenSSH for Windows allows remote denial of service over the network. This impacts secure shell connectivity essential for server and network administration tasks.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 OpenSSH 的资源耗尽缺陷允许通过网络进行远程拒绝服务攻击。这将影响服务器和网络管理任务所必需的 Secure Shell 连接。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthenticated remote code execution. As the backbone of corporate identity and access management, exploitation would grant domain-wide administrative control.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致未认证的远程代码执行。作为企业身份与访问管理的核心支柱，该漏洞被利用后将授予域级管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Services enables unauthenticated remote code execution. Widely deployed for remote access, this vulnerability provides a direct path to full server compromise without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Services 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现未认证的远程代码执行。该服务广泛用于远程访问，此漏洞为无需凭据即可完全控制服务器提供了直接途径。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in the DNS Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Disrupting or hijacking name resolution infrastructure can facilitate lateral movement and man-in-the-middle attacks at scale.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的类型混淆漏洞可导致未认证的远程代码执行。破坏或劫持名称解析基础设施将大规模促进横向移动和中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows HTTP.sys allows privilege escalation. Historically associated with catastrophic remote exploits; immediate remediation is critical regardless of the current local-authentication constraint.
items.reason_zh: Windows HTTP.sys 中的整数溢出漏洞可导致权限提升。历史上常与灾难性的远程漏洞利用相关联；无论当前是否受本地认证限制，立即修复都至关重要。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows iSCSI enables unauthenticated remote code execution. Directly impacts storage area networks (SAN) and enterprise storage routing, risking data availability and integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现未认证的远程代码执行。直接影响存储区域网络（SAN）和企业存储路由，危及数据的可用性与完整性。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution, threatening IP address management and facilitating lateral network movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的竞争条件漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁 IP 地址管理并促进网络横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in Windows iSCSI allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code remotely, compromising network-attached storage systems.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的释放后使用缺陷允许未认证的攻击者远程执行代码，破坏网络附加存储系统。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server exposes network configuration services to adjacent subnet attackers seeking to hijack routing and DNS.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞使网络配置服务暴露于相邻子网攻击者面前，这些攻击者试图劫持路由和 DNS。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free vulnerability in the DNS Server component allows network-based code execution, threatening critical name resolution infrastructure and enabling widespread reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 组件中的释放后使用漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，威胁关键名称解析基础设施并支持大规模侦察活动。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in Windows NAT enables network code execution, potentially disrupting internal routing, firewall functions, and network segmentation controls.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT 中的释放后使用缺陷可实现网络代码执行，可能破坏内部路由、防火墙功能及网络分段控制。

items.reason_en: A race condition in the SMB Server Network Transport Driver allows network code execution, significantly increasing the risk of lateral movement across enterprise environments.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server Network Transport Driver 中的竞争条件漏洞允许网络代码执行，显著增加企业环境内横向移动的风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows DHCP Server allows unauthorized remote code execution. Compromises network address assignment services and enables attackers to pivot across the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的越界写入漏洞允许未经授权的远程代码执行。破坏网络地址分配服务，并使攻击者能够跨网络进行跳板攻击。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Windows SMB Server allows authorized remote code execution. Weakens a critical file-sharing protocol commonly targeted for ransomware propagation and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Server 中的整数溢出漏洞允许已认证的远程代码执行。削弱了常被勒索软件传播和横向移动利用的关键文件共享协议。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Print Spooler allows unauthorized adjacent network code execution. Exploits a historically vulnerable service that facilitates network pivoting and malware deployment.
items.reason_zh: Windows Print Spooler 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经授权的相邻网络代码执行。利用了历史上易受攻击的服务，该服务便于网络跳板和恶意软件部署。

items.reason_en: Uncaught exception in Windows DNS allows unauthorized remote denial of service. Disrupts critical name resolution services essential for internal and external network operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的未捕获异常漏洞允许未经授权的远程拒绝服务攻击。破坏对内外网络操作至关重要的关键名称解析服务。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in DNS Server enables remote code execution, allowing attackers to manipulate name resolution and pivot across internal networks.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的越界写入漏洞可实现远程代码执行，使攻击者能够操纵名称解析并在内部网络中进行跳板攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server facilitates remote code execution, destabilizing core network resolution services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞促成远程代码执行，破坏核心网络解析服务的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server allows remote code execution, exploiting memory corruption in critical network infrastructure components.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，利用关键网络基础设施组件中的内存损坏问题。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows DHCP Server enables network code execution, directly targeting critical network infrastructure services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的越界读取漏洞可实现网络代码执行，直接针对关键网络基础设施服务。

items.reason_en: Invalid pointer release in Windows iSCSI allows network code execution, compromising storage networking protocols and availability.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的无效指针释放漏洞允许网络代码执行，破坏存储网络协议及可用性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server permits network code execution, exposing fundamental name resolution services to remote attackers.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许网络代码执行，使基础名称解析服务暴露给远程攻击者。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server enables network code execution, posing severe operational and security risks to DNS reliability.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现网络代码执行，对 DNS 可靠性构成严重的运营与安全风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Bluetooth A2DP driver allows adjacent network privilege escalation, impacting wireless connectivity stacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Bluetooth A2DP 驱动中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许相邻网络权限提升，影响无线连接协议栈。

items.reason_en: Double free in Windows DNS Server allows remote code execution (CVSS 9.8). This directly undermines core network resolution infrastructure and facilitates widespread lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中的双重释放漏洞可导致远程代码执行（CVSS 9.8）。这直接破坏了核心网络解析基础设施，并促进大规模横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in NGINX Plus worker processes enables remote code execution (CVSS 9.2). It severely impacts widely deployed reverse proxies and load balancers handling HTTP/2 traffic.
items.reason_zh: NGINX Plus 工作进程中的释放后使用漏洞可实现远程代码执行（CVSS 9.2）。严重影响了广泛部署的处理 HTTP/2 流量的反向代理和负载均衡器。

items.reason_en: Race condition in DHCP Server permits remote code execution (CVSS 7.5). This disrupts network address management and can be leveraged for unauthorized network access or configuration tampering.
items.reason_zh: DHCP服务器中的竞争条件可导致远程代码执行（CVSS 7.5）。该漏洞会破坏网络地址管理，并可被利用以实现未经授权的网络访问或配置篡改。

items.reason_en: Remote out-of-bounds read in TRENDnet router configuration CGI allows attackers to crash the device or leak sensitive memory contents.
items.reason_zh: TRENDnet路由器配置CGI中存在远程越界读取漏洞，攻击者可借此导致设备崩溃或泄露敏感内存内容。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution enables high-privileged local attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许高权限本地攻击者执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Flawed authentication state machine in Netatalk permits repeated login requests with released cryptographic handles, potentially bypassing network file server authentication.
items.reason_zh: Netatalk中的身份验证状态机存在缺陷，允许使用已释放的加密句柄重复发起登录请求，可能绕过网络文件服务器的身份验证。

items.reason_en: Critical argument injection in Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution enables remote command execution and unauthorized filesystem access by low-privileged attackers on adjacent networks.
items.reason_zh: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution中存在关键参数注入漏洞，允许相邻网络中的低权限攻击者实现远程命令执行及未授权的文件系统访问。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated adjacent network attackers can achieve arbitrary OS command execution on SonicOS distributions prior to version 4.6.1 via injected shell commands.
items.reason_zh: 未经认证的相邻网络攻击者可通过注入Shell命令，在4.6.1版本之前的SonicOS发行版上实现任意OS命令执行。

items.reason_en: Authenticated Hysteria clients can bypass UDP destination ACL restrictions by reusing established sessions to route traffic to localhost or private-network addresses.
items.reason_zh: 已认证的Hysteria客户端可通过重用已建立会话，将流量路由至本地回环地址或私有网络地址，从而绕过UDP目标ACL限制。

items.reason_en: Undertow incorrectly strips leading spaces from HTTP headers, violating RFC standards and enabling attackers to bypass security filters or perform request smuggling attacks.
items.reason_zh: Undertow错误地剥离HTTP头部的首空格，违反RFC标准，使攻击者能够绕过安全过滤器或实施请求走私攻击。

items.reason_en: Header parsing discrepancies between Undertow and upstream proxies allow remote attackers to craft requests that split traffic unpredictably, facilitating HTTP request smuggling exploits.
items.reason_zh: Undertow与上游代理之间的头部解析差异允许远程攻击者构造请求以不可预测地分割流量，从而助长HTTP请求走私漏洞利用。

items.reason_en: libsoup's WebSocket compression calculates truncated sizes for GByteArray growth, causing zlib to write past allocated buffers and resulting in heap buffer overflows during large message transmission.
items.reason_zh: libsoup的WebSocket压缩功能在计算GByteArray扩容时截断大小，导致zlib写入超出分配的缓冲区，在大消息传输期间引发堆缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Wing FTP Server generates predictable session identifiers derived from process, time, and IP state, allowing unauthenticated attackers to hijack administrator sessions and gain full server control.
items.reason_zh: Wing FTP Server生成的会话标识符可预测（基于进程、时间和IP状态），允许未认证攻击者劫持管理员会话并获取完整的服务器控制权。

items.reason_en: Samba's experimental vfs_ceph_rgw module contains an access control bypass in openat(), allowing authenticated users to read or overwrite restricted files on configured shares.
items.reason_zh: Samba的实验性vfs_ceph_rgw模块在openat()中存在访问控制绕过漏洞，允许已认证用户读取或覆盖配置共享中的受限文件。

items.reason_en: Known exploited vulnerability allowing server-to-server command injection via unescaped IRC labels compromises network integrity and relay trust.
items.reason_zh: 已知被利用的漏洞：通过未转义的IRC标签实现服务器间命令注入，损害网络完整性与中继信任关系。

items.reason_en: Crafted QEMU disk images trigger excessive resource consumption or memory corruption in the host, threatening virtualization stability.
items.reason_zh: 精心构造的QEMU磁盘镜像会触发宿主机过度资源消耗或内存损坏，威胁虚拟化环境的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Incorrect default permissions in Unbound allow unprivileged processes to modify DNS resolver configuration, enabling DNS hijacking or service disruption.
items.reason_zh: Unbound的错误默认权限允许非特权进程修改DNS解析器配置，从而导致DNS劫持或服务中断。

items.reason_en: Excess NTS Cookie fields in requests allow remote termination of the NTPsec daemon, disrupting critical time synchronization services.
items.reason_zh: 请求中过多的NTS Cookie字段可导致远程终止NTPsec守护进程，破坏关键的时间同步服务。

items.reason_en: Invalid MQTT CONNECT packets bypass size limits in Netty, causing memory exhaustion and denial-of-service in message broker deployments.
items.reason_zh: 无效的MQTT CONNECT数据包绕过Netty的大小限制，导致消息代理部署中出现内存耗尽和拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Disables Fast Open on MPTCP MP_JOIN subflows to prevent packet handling flaws that could lead to connection hijacking or denial-of-service.
items.reason_zh: 禁用MPTCP MP_JOIN子流上的Fast Open功能，以防止可能导致连接劫持或拒绝服务的报文处理缺陷。

items.reason_en: Fixes protected RX frame validation in wireless decrypt paths, blocking crafted frames from malicious access points from triggering kernel exploits.
items.reason_zh: 修复无线解密路径中的受保护RX帧验证机制，阻止来自恶意接入点的构造帧触发内核漏洞利用。

items.reason_en: Corrects use-after-free in raw IPv6 routing cache, preventing network stack instability and potential information leaks in routed environments.
items.reason_zh: 修正原始IPv6路由缓存中的释放后使用漏洞，防止路由环境中出现网络栈不稳定及潜在的信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Accounts for SCTP chunk padding during initialization, preventing buffer overflows when processing malformed transport layer packets.
items.reason_zh: 在初始化阶段考虑SCTP分块填充，防止在处理畸形传输层数据包时发生缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Improper handling of skb metadata before LWT encapsulation can corrupt network packets, leading to crashes or remote code execution in routers and firewalls.
items.reason_zh: LWT封装前对skb元数据的处理不当可能导致网络数据包损坏，进而引发路由器和防火墙崩溃或远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Double aggregation of flush-marked skbs in the Generic Receive Offload path causes memory corruption and creates a reliable vector for remote exploitation in network stacks.
items.reason_zh: 通用接收卸载路径中对标记刷新的skbs进行双重聚合会导致内存损坏，并为网络栈提供可靠的远程利用途径。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free during TCP socket migration failures can be triggered remotely to crash systems or execute arbitrary code in network-facing services and load balancers.
items.reason_zh: TCP套接字迁移失败期间的释放后使用漏洞可被远程触发，导致面向网络的服务和负载均衡器崩溃或执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in Azure Data Manager for Energy enables network RCE, directly threatening operational technology data pipelines and energy sector monitoring systems.
items.reason_zh: Azure Data Manager for Energy中的整数溢出漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，直接威胁运营技术数据管道及能源行业监控系统。

items.reason_en: Uses wire-declared frame sizes as memcpy bounds in rt-labs EtherCAT CoE implementation, allowing masters to write beyond allocated application buffers.
items.reason_zh: rt-labs EtherCAT CoE实现在memcpy边界检查中使用了线框声明的帧大小，允许主站写入超出分配的应用程序缓冲区。

items.reason_en: Insufficient input validation in WAGO Web-Based Management allows low-privileged remote attackers to inject shell commands into routing configurations processed by root scripts.
items.reason_zh: WAGO Web-Based Management输入验证不足，允许低权限远程攻击者向由root脚本处理的路由配置中注入Shell命令。

items.reason_en: Fails to track total written bytes during segmented CoE SDO downloads, allowing masters to walk pointers past object buffers and corrupt memory.
items.reason_zh: 分段CoE SDO下载过程中未能跟踪已写入总字节数，允许主站指针越过对象缓冲区并造成内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Flawed authorization in WAGO WBM allows low-privileged remote attackers to modify critical PROFIBUS device parameters, disrupting industrial automation networks.
items.reason_zh: WAGO WBM中的授权逻辑缺陷允许低权限远程攻击者修改关键的PROFIBUS设备参数，破坏工业自动化网络。

items.reason_en: Stops originator purge workers before freeing translation tables, preventing race conditions in mesh routing daemons used for industrial telemetry.
items.reason_zh: 在释放转换表之前停止源发起者的清理工作线程，防止用于工业遥测的网状路由守护进程中发生竞争条件。

items.reason_en: Ignores incorrectly set ROAM flags in received ADD changes, ensuring accurate client tracking and preventing routing loops in factory mesh networks.
items.reason_zh: 忽略接收到的 ADD 变更中错误设置的 ROAM 标志，以确保准确跟踪客户端并防止工厂网状网络中出现路由环路。

items.reason_en: Clears ROAM flags when re-adding pending local clients, fixing state corruption that could disrupt critical real-time mesh communication.
items.reason_zh: 在重新添加挂起的本地客户端时清除 ROAM 标志，修复可能导致关键实时网状通信中断的状态损坏问题。

items.reason_en: Protects CAN receive lists with per-device locks, preventing concurrent namespace migration issues in industrial control vehicle networks.
items.reason_zh: 通过设备级锁保护 CAN 接收列表，防止工业控制车载网络中发生并发命名空间迁移问题。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in EUSurvey's import functionality allows authenticated Form Managers to execute arbitrary server-side code by manipulating archive entry names.
items.reason_zh: EUSurvey 导入功能中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证的表单管理员通过操纵归档条目名称执行任意服务器端代码。

items.reason_en: Bulk change authorization bypass in EUSurvey permits any authenticated user to arbitrarily take over or delete other users' surveys, breaking multi-tenant data isolation.
items.reason_zh: EUSurvey 存在批量更改授权绕过漏洞，允许任何已认证用户任意接管或删除其他用户的调查，从而破坏多租户数据隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated image save handler in MyMangaDB accepts client-controlled filenames, enabling directory traversal and potential remote code execution on self-hosted instances.
items.reason_zh: MyMangaDB 中存在未授权的图像保存处理程序，可接受客户端控制的文件名，从而导致目录遍历并在自托管实例上引发潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: ASP.NET Core contains a code injection vulnerability enabling network RCE. This directly compromises server-side web application logic and framework integrity.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在代码注入漏洞，可导致网络层面的远程代码执行（RCE），直接破坏服务器端 Web 应用逻辑与框架完整性。

items.reason_en: WebDAV suffers from improper path resolution allowing network privilege escalation. This impacts enterprise file sharing services and web-deployed storage endpoints.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 存在路径解析不当漏洞，可导致网络层面的权限提升，影响企业文件共享服务及基于 Web 部署的存储端点。

items.reason_en: .NET exhibits asymmetric resource consumption leading to network denial of service. This threatens web service availability and requires rate-limiting or resource throttling mitigations.
items.reason_zh: .NET 存在资源消耗不对称问题，可导致网络拒绝服务（DoS），威胁 Web 服务可用性，需通过速率限制或资源节流进行缓解。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in .NET Framework permits remote code execution via crafted web application requests.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，攻击者可通过构造恶意 Web 请求实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in victim browsers.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，允许攻击者在受害者浏览器中执行任意脚本。
