items.reason_en: Integer overflow in SharePoint leads to remote code execution in enterprise web deployment environments.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在整数溢出漏洞，可在企业 Web 部署环境中导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint facilitates internal network reconnaissance and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，可被用于内部网络侦察与横向移动。

items.reason_en: HTTP request smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows network-level request tampering and cache poisoning, severely degrading web application integrity and security.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在 HTTP 请求走私漏洞，可导致网络层级的请求篡改与缓存投毒，严重破坏 Web 应用的完整性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables phishing, credential theft, and session hijacking against webmail and Outlook client interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞针对 Webmail 及 Outlook 客户端界面实施网络钓鱼、凭据窃取与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server permits remote code execution via malicious emails, directly compromising enterprise mail infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可通过发送恶意邮件实现远程代码执行，直接危及企业邮件基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Exchange Server allows privilege escalation within the mail environment, risking unauthorized administrative actions and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 存在授权校验错误漏洞，允许在邮件系统内提升权限，可能导致未授权的后台管理操作及数据外泄。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 untrusted pointer dereference in WebDAV can lead to local privilege escalation when exploited through misconfigured or externally exposed webdav endpoints.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 存在 CVSS 评分为 7.8 的不可信指针解引用漏洞，当通过配置不当或对外暴露的 WebDAV 端点进行利用时，可导致本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 improper access control in WebDAV allows authenticated users to elevate privileges locally, undermining secure file sharing protocols and internal network segmentation.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 存在 CVSS 评分为 7.8 的访问控制不当漏洞，允许已认证用户在本地提升权限，破坏安全文件共享协议及内部网络隔离策略。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows network attackers to execute arbitrary code, jeopardizing enterprise content management systems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 存在缺失授权验证漏洞，允许网络攻击者执行任意代码，危及企业内容管理系统的安全。

items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在严重的授权缺陷，允许通过网络进行权限提升，破坏租户隔离机制与数据访问控制策略。

items.reason_en: SharePoint execution with unnecessary privileges enables network-based privilege escalation, weakening web application security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 以非必要特权运行会导致基于网络的权限提升，削弱 Web 应用的安全边界。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint facilitates remote code execution, directly impacting web service integrity.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在对不可信数据进行反序列化的漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，直接破坏 Web 服务的完整性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables network-based spoofing and credential theft through injected malicious scripts.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，攻击者可通过注入恶意脚本实施网络层面的欺骗攻击与凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: Additional XSS vulnerability in SharePoint highlights persistent input validation gaps requiring urgent remediation.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中发现的额外 XSS 漏洞凸显了输入验证机制的持续缺失，亟需紧急修复。

items.reason_zh: IIS 的本地权限提升漏洞可与初始 Webshell 上传相结合，从而获取完整系统控制权，破坏 Web 服务器的隔离模型。

items.reason_en: Significant 8.1 CVSS cross-site scripting vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables unauthorized attackers to perform spoofing attacks, compromising user trust and session integrity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 存在 CVSS 评分高达 8.1 的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可使未授权攻击者实施欺骗攻击，破坏用户信任与会话完整性。

items.reason_en: Moderate-to-high 7.5 CVSS cross-site scripting flaw in Microsoft Teams allows network-based spoofing attacks, potentially disrupting collaborative workflows and stealing credentials.

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in SharePoint allows network-based remote code execution, compromising content management and collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 存在路径遍历漏洞，可导致基于网络的远程代码执行，危及内容管理与协作平台的安全。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in the Authentication Methods Portal Extension enables network privilege escalation, weakening identity management controls.

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in the Profile Data Roaming Service allows network privilege escalation, exposing internal service endpoints.
items.reason_zh: 配置文件数据漫游服务中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可导致网络权限提升，从而暴露内部服务端点。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint enables privilege escalation over the network, allowing attackers to access sensitive content and elevate their permissions within the web application.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的授权缺失漏洞可允许攻击者通过网络进行权限提升，从而访问敏感内容并在Web应用程序中提升自身权限。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Visual Studio Code allows attackers to bypass security controls and access internal resources, highlighting risks in developer toolchains exposed to networks.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可使攻击者绕过安全控制并访问内部资源，凸显了暴露于网络的开发者工具链所面临的风险。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core enables network feature bypass, undermining WAF and proxy security controls.

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in SharePoint facilitates network RCE, targeting enterprise collaboration platforms used across organizations.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的堆溢出漏洞可促成网络远程代码执行（RCE），主要面向跨组织广泛使用的企业协作平台。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint allows network privilege escalation, exploiting backend query handling to manipulate enterprise data.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的SQL注入漏洞可导致网络权限提升，攻击者可通过利用后端查询处理机制来操纵企业数据。

items.reason_en: Bypass of security checks in .NET allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely via manipulated standard inputs.

items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 9.0 的 Microsoft Office SharePoint 跨站脚本漏洞可支持通过网络进行权限提升，直接影响 Web 应用完整性与用户会话安全。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 JScript integer overflow allows remote code execution via crafted scripts, maintaining relevance for legacy web automation and browser-based attack chains.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 7.5 的 JScript 整数溢出漏洞允许通过构造脚本执行远程代码，在遗留 Web 自动化及基于浏览器的攻击链中仍具威胁。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.8 HTTP.sys heap overflow permits local privilege escalation, affecting the core Windows web networking stack utilized by IIS and other HTTP services.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分为 7.8 的 HTTP.sys 堆溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，影响 IIS 及其他 HTTP 服务所依赖的核心 Windows Web 网络协议栈。

items.reason_en: Deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint carries a high EPSS score, indicating active exploitation potential for remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的反序列化漏洞拥有较高的 EPSS 评分，表明存在被积极利用以执行远程代码的风险。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass flaws in Microsoft Teams allow attackers to assume administrative roles and exfiltrate organizational data across collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Teams 的身份验证绕过漏洞可使攻击者冒充管理员角色，并在协作平台间窃取组织数据。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge facilitates drive-by downloads and session hijacking affecting millions of end-users.
items.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Microsoft Edge 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致恶意软件旁加载与会话劫持，波及数百万终端用户。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization logic in ASP.NET Core allows network-based privilege escalation, severely undermining web application security boundaries and session management.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的错误授权逻辑可导致基于网络的权限提升，严重破坏 Web 应用的安全边界与会话管理机制。

items.reason_en: A race condition in ASP.NET Core shared resources enables local privilege escalation, highlighting concurrency handling deficiencies in modern web frameworks.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 共享资源中存在竞争条件漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，暴露出现代 Web 框架在并发处理机制上的缺陷。

items.reason_en: An authorization bypass in Visual Studio Code via user-controlled keys allows local security feature circumvention, directly impacting developer workflow integrity.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中通过用户可控键值实现的授权绕过漏洞可规避本地安全特性，直接影响开发者工作流的安全性。

items.reason_en: External control of file name or path in Skype for Business allows unauthorized remote code execution. Allows attackers to execute arbitrary code by manipulating file paths within the communication platform.
items.reason_zh: Skype for Business 的文件名或路径外部控制漏洞可导致未授权的远程代码执行。攻击者可利用该漏洞操纵通信平台内的文件路径以执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Denial of service in React server-side DOM rendering libraries allows attackers to crash endpoints via crafted HTTP requests. Impacts modern web application stability and availability.
items.reason_zh: React 服务端 DOM 渲染库中的拒绝服务（DoS）漏洞允许攻击者通过构造恶意 HTTP 请求导致服务节点崩溃，严重影响现代 Web 应用的稳定性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Command injection in M365 Copilot allows authorized remote privilege escalation. Demonstrates how AI-integrated web applications can become vectors for system-level compromise.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 中的命令注入漏洞可导致授权用户的远程权限提升，揭示了集成 AI 的 Web 应用可能演变为系统级沦陷的攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Chromium-based Edge allows remote code execution from malicious websites, affecting a major browser ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Edge 中的堆溢出漏洞允许从恶意网站执行远程代码，对主流浏览器生态构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Type confusion vulnerability in Edge enables remote code execution, bypassing modern browser security mitigations.
items.reason_zh: Edge 中的类型混淆漏洞可导致远程代码执行，从而绕过现代浏览器的安全缓解机制。

items.reason_en: Unthrottled resource allocation in ASP.NET Core allows unauthenticated denial-of-service attacks against web applications.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 缺乏资源分配限速机制，可导致针对 Web 应用的未授权拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

items.reason_en: Untrusted search path in Visual Studio Code enables network code execution, targeting developer workflows and IDE ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 的不受信任搜索路径漏洞可导致网络代码执行，直接威胁开发者工作流及 IDE 生态系统安全。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Tools for Applications and SSMS allows network code execution during development and database management tasks.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Tools for Applications 与 SSMS 中的代码注入漏洞可在开发与数据库管理过程中触发网络代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Access permits network code execution via malicious database files, remaining a common phishing vector.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Access 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过恶意数据库文件执行网络代码，仍是常见的网络钓鱼攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in SharePoint allows remote code execution (CVSS 8.8). This targets enterprise collaboration platforms where processed documents may contain malicious serialized payloads.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的不安全反序列化漏洞可导致远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8），主要威胁企业协作平台，因处理过的文档可能包含恶意序列化负载。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in WHMCS exposes sensitive billing and admin data (CVSS 8.7). Hosting management suites become vulnerable to complete credential theft without requiring valid login credentials.
items.reason_zh: WHMCS 中的未授权 SQL 注入漏洞可泄露敏感计费与管理数据（CVSS 8.7），致使托管管理平台在未提供有效登录凭据的情况下面临凭证完全被盗的风险。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in Admidio allows persistent script injection by role administrators (CVSS 8.1). Community management sites face ongoing risks of session hijacking, defacement, and user tracking.
items.reason_zh: Admidio 中的存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞允许角色管理员持久化注入脚本（CVSS 8.1），使社区管理类网站持续面临会话劫持、页面篡改及用户追踪风险。

items.reason_en: @fastify/express fails to rewrite regex mount paths for parameterized prefixes, causing middleware routing mismatches and potential security control bypasses.
items.reason_zh: @fastify/express 未能正确重写带参数的挂载路径正则表达式，导致中间件路由错配及潜在的安全控制绕过。

items.reason_en: Grav CMS API plugin allows publishers to upload malicious Twig templates via blueprint uploads, leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Grav CMS API 插件允许发布者通过蓝图上传恶意 Twig 模板，从而导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization logic in Tabbycat returns true for views lacking tournament attributes, granting unauthenticated users write access to tournament data.
items.reason_zh: Tabbycat 的错误授权逻辑在处理缺乏赛事属性的视图时错误返回真值，导致未授权用户可写入赛事数据。

items.reason_en: Actix-files allows remote unauthenticated attackers to bypass dotfile restrictions by requesting Windows 8.3 short-name aliases to read hidden configuration files.
items.reason_zh: Actix-files 允许远程未授权攻击者通过请求 Windows 8.3 短文件名别名绕过隐藏文件限制，从而读取隐藏的配置文件。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in WordPress occurs because the plugin splices attacker-controlled URIs into PHP expressions and evaluates them via eval() without sanitization.
items.reason_zh: WordPress 远程代码执行漏洞源于插件将攻击者可控的 URI 拼接至 PHP 表达式中，并未经过滤直接通过 eval() 执行。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass allows unauthenticated attackers to gain Administrator roles in SiYuan by spoofing X-Forwarded-For headers through loopback-trusted reverse proxies.
items.reason_zh: 身份验证绕过漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过回环信任的反向代理伪造 X-Forwarded-For 请求头，从而在 SiYuan 中获取管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Unbounded decompression of HTTP request bodies before authentication enables rapid resource exhaustion attacks against MISP threat intelligence platforms.
items.reason_zh: 在身份验证之前对HTTP请求体进行无限制解压缩，可导致针对MISP威胁情报平台的快速资源耗尽攻击。

items.reason_en: Authorization flaws allow non-admin users to create or import threat intelligence records attributed to other organizations, compromising data integrity and operational trust.
items.reason_zh: 授权缺陷允许非管理员用户创建或导入归属于其他组织的威胁情报记录，破坏数据完整性与操作信任。

items.reason_en: Simple Shopping Cart suffers from deserialization of untrusted data, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary objects and achieve remote code execution within WordPress environments.
items.reason_zh: Simple Shopping Cart存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者注入任意对象并在WordPress环境中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Nexter Blocks Pro's privilege escalation flaw bypasses Unicode-aware denylists, enabling any registered user to elevate privileges to administrator level through crafted AJAX parameters.
items.reason_zh: Nexter Blocks Pro的权限提升缺陷绕过了支持Unicode的黑名单，使任何注册用户都可通过构造的AJAX参数将权限提升至管理员级别。

items.reason_en: Metagauss ProfileGrid allows object injection via deserialization of untrusted data, compromising community and profile management features and potentially leading to full site takeover.
items.reason_zh: Metagauss ProfileGrid可通过反序列化不受信任的数据实现对象注入，破坏社区和配置文件管理功能，并可能导致整个网站被接管。

items.reason_en: ServiceNow AI Platform contains a code injection vulnerability that allows authenticated template editors to execute arbitrary code within the context of other users' active sessions.
items.reason_zh: ServiceNow AI Platform包含代码注入漏洞，允许已认证的模板编辑者在其他用户的活跃会话上下文中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Future AGI's authentication bypass in ACSView.post allows organization members to take over accounts in other tenants by asserting arbitrary email addresses through controlled identity providers.
items.reason_zh: Future AGI的ACSView.post身份验证绕过漏洞允许组织成员通过受控的身份提供商断言任意电子邮件地址，从而接管其他租户中的账户。

items.reason_en: Host header validation failure in Undertow enables phishing and cache poisoning attacks in Java web applications.
items.reason_zh: Undertow的主机头验证失败漏洞可使Java Web应用程序遭受钓鱼和缓存投毒攻击。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in libsoup HTTP server allows memory corruption and potential remote code execution via crafted requests targeting web proxies.
items.reason_zh: libsoup HTTP服务器存在释放后使用漏洞，允许通过针对Web代理的构造请求导致内存损坏及潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Kirby chunked uploads bypasses SVG sanitization, enabling stored cross-site scripting attacks on web applications.
items.reason_zh: Kirby分块上传存在竞态条件漏洞，可绕过SVG过滤，从而在Web应用程序中启用存储型跨站脚本攻击。

items.reason_en: Incorrect privilege assignment in GiveWP allows attackers to escalate user roles and gain unauthorized administrative access to WordPress sites.
items.reason_zh: GiveWP中存在错误的权限分配漏洞，允许攻击者提升用户角色并获得对WordPress站点的未授权管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in a widely used WordPress plugin allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into legitimate web pages, compromising end-user sessions and site integrity.
items.reason_zh: 一款广泛使用的WordPress插件存在存储型跨站脚本漏洞，允许攻击者将恶意脚本注入合法网页，破坏终端用户会话与站点完整性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Red Hat's glib URI escaping function can be triggered by malformed input strings, affecting widely deployed middleware and application stacks.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat的glib URI转义函数存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可由格式错误的输入字符串触发，影响广泛部署的中间件与应用栈。

items.reason_en: Improper error handling when using ChaCha20 with OpenSSL in libssh may result in partially initialized cipher contexts, potentially weakening cryptographic communications.
items.reason_zh: libssh在使用OpenSSL调用ChaCha20时存在错误处理不当问题，可能导致加密上下文部分初始化，从而削弱加密通信的安全性。

items.reason_en: mssql-mcp-core interpolates caller-controlled identifiers into T-SQL batches without proper parameterization, enabling SQL injection attacks against database tooling.
items.reason_zh: mssql-mcp-core在未进行适当参数化的情况下将调用方控制的标识符插入T-SQL批处理中，导致针对数据库工具的SQL注入攻击。

items.reason_en: Dynamics Business Central contains a path traversal flaw allowing network privilege escalation. This compromises enterprise ERP middleware integrity and data access controls.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central存在路径遍历漏洞，可导致网络权限提升。该漏洞破坏了企业ERP中间件的完整性与数据访问控制。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Dynamics Business Central enables network RCE. This critical middleware vulnerability bypasses security checks and allows arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行（RCE）。此关键中间件漏洞绕过了安全检查并允许执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution through malicious database queries or connections.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server存在堆溢出漏洞，可通过恶意数据库查询或连接实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Azure Database for PostgreSQL allows privilege escalation over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure Database for PostgreSQL存在授权不当漏洞，可导致通过网络进行权限提升。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, threatening database availability, integrity, and confidential data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行，威胁数据库可用性、完整性及机密数据。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager grants privilege escalation and unauthorized control over enterprise device management and deployment platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Configuration Manager存在SQL注入漏洞，可导致权限提升并对企业设备管理与部署平台获得未授权控制。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in SQL Server allows authenticated local users to escalate privileges, potentially leading to full system compromise and data exposure.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server存在整数溢出漏洞，允许已认证的本地用户提升权限，可能导致系统完全沦陷及数据泄露。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 SQL injection flaw in SQL Server allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges and manipulate data over the network, severely compromising database integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在CVSS 8.8的SQL注入漏洞，允许未授权攻击者通过网络提升权限并操纵数据，严重破坏数据库完整性与机密性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, threatening critical backend infrastructure and service availability.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在CVSS 8.8的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行，威胁关键后端基础设施与服务可用性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server enables remote code execution, threatening critical database infrastructure accessible over the network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，威胁可通过网络访问的关键数据库基础设施。

items.reason_en: An integer overflow in SQL Server allows unauthorized network attackers to execute arbitrary code, risking complete database compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在整数溢出漏洞，允许未授权的网络攻击者执行任意代码，面临数据库完全沦陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in SQL Server permits network-based privilege escalation, undermining database security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在访问控制不当漏洞，允许基于网络的权限提升，破坏了数据库安全边界。

items.reason_en: Deserialization vulnerability in SQL Server permits remote code execution, directly threatening database integrity and backend application logic.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在反序列化漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，直接威胁数据库完整性与后端应用逻辑。

items.reason_en: Untrusted data deserialization in SQL Server allows network-based code execution, bypassing standard authentication controls when misconfigured.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在不信任数据反序列化漏洞，在配置错误时可绕过标准身份验证控制机制，允许基于网络的代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL enables remote code execution, compromising data access layers and enterprise analytics pipelines.
items.reason_zh: SQL的WDAC OLE DB提供程序存在堆溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，破坏数据访问层与企业分析管道。

items.reason_en: Critical 9.8 CVSS heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, directly jeopardizing database integrity and confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在 CVSS 评分 9.8（严重）的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行任意代码，直接危及数据库的完整性与机密性。

items.reason_en: Severe 8.8 CVSS SQL injection flaw in SQL Server enables authorized attackers to escalate privileges and manipulate database operations over a network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在 CVSS 评分 8.8（严重）的 SQL 注入漏洞，使授权攻击者能够通过网络提升权限并操纵数据库操作。

items.reason_en: High-risk 8.8 CVSS command injection vulnerability in SQL Server permits unauthorized remote code execution, bypassing standard database security controls.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在 CVSS 评分 8.8（高危）的命令注入漏洞，允许未授权远程代码执行，从而绕过标准数据库安全控制。

items.reason_en: Critical 8.8 CVSS SQL injection issue in SQL Server allows privilege escalation over a network, requiring immediate patching to prevent database compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中存在 CVSS 评分 8.8（严重）的 SQL 注入漏洞，允许攻击者通过网络提升权限，需立即修补以防止数据库遭入侵。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra permits network-based code execution, directly compromising database integrity.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra 中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许基于网络的代码执行，直接危及数据库完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper output encoding in Active Directory Certificate Services allows local privilege escalation, undermining PKI trust foundations.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Certificate Services 存在输出编码不当漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，削弱公钥基础设施（PKI）的信任基础。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Microsoft Configuration Manager allows privilege escalation over an adjacent network, risking unauthorized database manipulation and administrative control.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Configuration Manager 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，允许通过相邻网络提升权限，存在未经授权操纵数据库及获取管理控制权的風險。

items.reason_en: Remote out-of-bounds write in the .NET runtime enables arbitrary code execution, affecting a wide range of cross-platform applications and middleware dependent on the framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET runtime 存在远程越界写入漏洞，可导致任意代码执行，影响大量依赖该框架的跨平台应用与中间件。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Azure SQL Database enables network privilege escalation, compromising core relational database services and tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 存在 SSRF 漏洞，可实现网络权限提升，危及核心关系型数据库服务与租户隔离机制。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database allows network privilege escalation, representing a critical and frequently exploited database attack vector.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，可实现网络权限提升，属于关键且常被利用的数据库攻击面。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Azure SQL Database permits network privilege escalation, weakening multi-tenant security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 存在访问控制不当漏洞，可实现网络权限提升，削弱多租户安全边界。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core enables network DoS, threatening web server stability and availability under heavy load.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在资源耗尽漏洞，可引发网络拒绝服务（DoS），在重负载下威胁 Web 服务器的稳定性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the .NET runtime allows network RCE, impacting a vast ecosystem of cross-platform applications and middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: .NET runtime 存在越界写入漏洞，可导致网络远程代码执行（RCE），影响庞大的跨平台应用与中间件部署生态。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in Azure SQL Database allows local privilege escalation within the database engine, risking data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 存在权限分配错误漏洞，可在数据库引擎内部实现本地权限提升，危及数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion flaw in ASP.NET Core enables targeted denial-of-service attacks against web applications and backend middleware.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在资源耗尽漏洞，可针对 Web 应用及后端中间件实施定向拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in SQL Server allows authenticated attackers to execute code over the network, risking full database compromise and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在堆溢出漏洞，允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过网络执行代码，可能导致数据库完全失陷及数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET framework enables remote code execution without authentication, affecting a vast ecosystem of backend applications and APIs.
items.reason_zh: .NET framework 存在对不可信数据进行反序列化的漏洞，可实现免认证远程代码执行，影响庞大的后端应用与 API 生态。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in SQL Server permits network-based code execution by authorized users, undermining database integrity and enabling lateral movement within internal networks.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在堆溢出漏洞，允许授权用户进行基于网络的代码执行，破坏数据库完整性并为内部网络横向移动创造条件。

items.reason_en: Relative path traversal in .NET Framework allows local privilege escalation, potentially bypassing application sandbox restrictions and accessing sensitive system paths.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 存在相对路径遍历漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，可能绕过应用沙箱限制并访问敏感系统路径。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits remote code execution, jeopardizing critical database infrastructure and data integrity.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，危及关键数据库基础设施与数据完整性。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerability in SQL Server allows network-based privilege escalation, bypassing standard database access controls.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在 SQL 注入漏洞，可实现基于网络的权限提升，从而绕过标准数据库访问控制。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via capture-replay in Exchange Server enables remote privilege escalation, severely compromising email infrastructure security.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 存在通过捕获重放绕过身份验证的漏洞，可导致远程权限提升，严重危及邮件基础设施安全。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the .NET framework allows local privilege escalation, affecting countless enterprise applications built on this middleware.
items.reason_zh: .NET framework 存在整数溢出漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，影响大量基于该中间件构建的企业应用。

items.reason_en: Injection flaw in SQL Server permits network privilege escalation with a CVSS of 9.6, representing a critical risk to database integrity and access controls.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在注入漏洞（CVSS 评分 9.6），可实现网络权限提升，对数据库完整性与访问控制构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in SQL Server allows unauthorized network code execution. Memory corruption in the database engine directly threatens data confidentiality and system stability.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在越界读取漏洞，可导致未授权的网络代码执行。数据库引擎内的内存损坏直接威胁数据机密性与系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in SQL Server enables unauthorized network code execution. This high-severity flaw exploits core database service boundaries for remote compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在不可信指针解引用漏洞，可导致未授权的网络代码执行。该高危漏洞利用核心数据库服务边界实现远程入侵。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits authorized network code execution. Exploiting database service memory handling weaknesses can lead to full system takeover.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许授权的网络代码执行。利用数据库服务内存处理缺陷可导致系统被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Resource allocation without limits in ASP.NET Core allows unauthorized network denial of service. Application availability is directly impacted by unthrottled resource consumption.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在资源分配无限制漏洞，可导致未授权的网络拒绝服务。缺乏限流的资源消耗将直接影响应用可用性。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in .NET enables network denial of service. Vulnerabilities to algorithmic complexity attacks degrade middleware performance and reliability.
items.reason_zh: .NET 存在算法复杂度效率低下漏洞，可引发网络拒绝服务。此类算法复杂度攻击漏洞会降低中间件的性能与可靠性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the .NET runtime allows local privilege escalation, potentially compromising applications relying on this core middleware framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET runtime 存在整数溢出漏洞，可导致本地权限提升，可能危及依赖该核心中间件框架的应用程序。

items.reason_en: Sensitive information leakage in .NET Aspire can expose credentials or internal configurations during local development and deployment workflows.
items.reason_zh: .NET Aspire 中的敏感信息泄露可能在本地开发和部署工作流中暴露凭据或内部配置。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.7 JDBC Driver cryptographic signature verification failure allows attackers to bypass security controls and inject malicious payloads during database connections.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.7 JDBC 驱动程序密码学签名验证失败，允许攻击者在数据库连接期间绕过安全控制并注入恶意负载。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 WDAC OLE DB provider heap overflow permits remote code execution, exploiting database connectivity layers to compromise backend data systems.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序堆溢出允许远程代码执行，利用数据库连接层破坏后端数据系统。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 SQL Server heap overflow allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over a network, risking full database engine compromise and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5 SQL Server 堆溢出允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，可能导致整个数据库引擎被攻破及数据外泄。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Azure SQL Database enables attackers to extract sensitive data, modify schemas, or escalate to system-level access in managed environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database 中的 SQL 注入使攻击者能够提取敏感数据、修改架构，或在托管环境中提升至系统级访问权限。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in SQL Server allows remote code execution, directly threatening data integrity and availability across enterprise database deployments.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的堆溢出允许远程代码执行，直接威胁企业数据库部署中的数据完整性和可用性。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Online allows unauthenticated attackers to interact with internal mail components, leading to full mailbox compromise.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Online 中的 SSRF 漏洞允许未经身份验证的攻击者与内部邮件组件交互，导致邮箱完全被攻破。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits local code execution, risking data integrity, service availability, and compliance within database environments.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许本地代码执行，危及数据库环境中的数据完整性、服务可用性及合规性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows unauthorized remote code execution. A critical flaw in the industry-standard database engine that could lead to full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许未授权的远程代码执行。这是行业标准数据库引擎中的一个关键缺陷，可能导致整个系统被攻破。

items.reason_en: Double free in Microsoft Exchange Server allows unauthorized remote code execution. Targets email infrastructure, potentially enabling mailbox theft or spam relay abuse.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server 中的双重释放漏洞允许未授权的远程代码执行。该漏洞针对电子邮件基础设施，可能导致邮箱被盗或垃圾邮件中继滥用。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SQL Server allows authorized remote privilege escalation. Bypasses input validation to manipulate database queries and escalate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入允许已授权用户进行远程权限提升。通过绕过输入验证来操纵数据库查询，并在网络上提升权限。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in SQL Server allows remote code execution over the network, directly endangering critical database services.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，直接危及关键数据库服务。

items.reason_en: Stack-based overflow in SQL Server enables privilege escalation over the network, potentially granting full control over database instances.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于栈的溢出允许通过网络进行权限提升，可能授予对数据库实例的完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables remote code execution and privilege escalation, jeopardizing enterprise collaboration and content management systems.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的代码注入可实现远程代码执行和权限提升，危及企业协作和内容管理系统。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows remote privilege escalation, directly threatening database integrity and sensitive data storage.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出允许远程权限提升，直接威胁数据库完整性和敏感数据存储。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Exchange Online permits remote code execution, disrupting email infrastructure and enabling mailbox takeover.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Online 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出允许远程代码执行，破坏电子邮件基础设施并实现邮箱接管。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables network code execution, threatening core database engine integrity and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出支持网络代码执行，威胁核心数据库引擎完整性和数据机密性。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in SQL Server allows network privilege escalation, potentially bypassing database security controls.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的不受信任指针解引用允许通过网络进行权限提升，可能绕过数据库安全控制。

items.reason_en: External file path control in Dynamics Business Central enables network privilege escalation, directly impacting ERP business logic and access controls.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central 中的外部文件路径控制允许通过网络进行权限提升，直接影响 ERP 业务逻辑和访问控制。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Dynamics Business Central allows network information disclosure, exposing sensitive business data without proper access verification.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central 中的身份验证不当允许网络信息泄露，在未进行适当访问验证的情况下暴露敏感业务数据。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution (CVSS 8.8). This directly compromises enterprise database engines and the integrity of stored organizational data.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出支持远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8）。这直接破坏了企业数据库引擎及存储的组织数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Buffer over-read in Elasticsearch transport leaks data across shared network buffers (CVSS 7.5). Decompression flaws expose sensitive information from unrelated requests during LZ4 decoding operations.
items.reason_zh: Elasticsearch 传输协议中的缓冲区越界读取会在共享网络缓冲区中泄露数据（CVSS 7.5）。解压缺陷在 LZ4 解码操作期间会暴露来自无关请求的敏感信息。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL allows remote code execution (CVSS 8.8). Exploiting this database connectivity middleware bypasses Windows Defender Application Guard security policies.
items.reason_zh: SQL 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出允许远程代码执行（CVSS 8.8）。利用此数据库连接中间件可绕过 Windows Defender Application Guard 安全策略。

items.reason_en: SurrealDB's MCP server treats the first backtick as a closing delimiter, ignoring escape characters and enabling SQL injection attacks.
items.reason_zh: SurrealDB 的 MCP 服务器将第一个反引号视为结束定界符，忽略转义字符，从而启用 SQL 注入攻击。

items.reason_en: PostgreSQL JDBC Driver misparses quoted text containing braces, incorrectly translating literal suffixes as SQL escape sequences and enabling injection.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL JDBC 驱动程序错误解析包含大括号的引号文本，将字面量后缀错误翻译为 SQL 转义序列，从而导致注入漏洞。

items.reason_en: ArcadeDB incorrectly scopes ACLs by type name without propagating renames, allowing schema-updating users to bypass permissions and access unknown types.
items.reason_zh: ArcadeDB 按类型名称错误地限定 ACL 作用域且未传播重命名操作，允许模式更新用户绕过权限并访问未知类型。

items.reason_en: Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE compiler component could allow privileged attackers to exploit improper input validation, potentially impacting runtime security and JIT compilation safety.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Java SE 编译器组件中的漏洞可能允许特权攻击者利用不正确的输入验证，进而影响运行时安全和 JIT 编译安全性。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass skips per-type ACL checks when ArcadeDB opens databases on demand, allowing authenticated users to read and write restricted collections.
items.reason_zh: 当 ArcadeDB 按需打开数据库时，授权绕过跳过了按类型的 ACL 检查，允许经过身份验证的用户读写受限集合。

items.reason_en: The embedded JavaScript scripting engine bypasses function capability checks, enabling denied users to execute privileged synchronous and asynchronous database dispatchers.
items.reason_zh: 嵌入式 JavaScript 脚本引擎绕过了函数能力检查，使被拒绝的用户能够执行特权同步和异步数据库调度器。

items.reason_en: FOR loop variable shadowing tricks table permission checks, allowing authenticated users to satisfy access controls and read protected $access and $auth variables.
items.reason_zh: FOR 循环变量遮蔽欺骗了表权限检查，允许经过身份验证的用户满足访问控制并读取受保护的 $access 和 $auth 变量。

items.reason_en: Missing containment checks on unsanitized deployment names in WildFly/JBoss allow directory traversal, enabling attackers to overwrite critical server files.
items.reason_zh: WildFly/JBoss 中未清理的部署名称缺少隔离检查，可导致目录遍历漏洞，使攻击者能够覆盖关键服务器文件。

items.reason_en: Malformed Redis cluster bus packets fail null-termination validation, triggering out-of-bounds reads that could leak sensitive memory contents from the node.
items.reason_zh: 格式错误的 Redis 集群总线数据包未能通过空终止符验证，触发越界读取，可能导致节点敏感内存内容泄露。

items.reason_en: FreeIPA's Kerberos principal uniqueness constraint fails to account for equivalent name representations, allowing LDAP writers to escalate privileges by creating conflicting principal entries.
items.reason_zh: FreeIPA 的 Kerberos 主体唯一性约束未考虑等效名称表示形式，允许 LDAP 写入者通过创建冲突的主体条目提升权限。

items.reason_en: DBI addresses critical flaws in database interaction layers affecting RHEL systems, resolving incomplete mitigations that could otherwise expose backend services to injection or bypass attacks.
items.reason_zh: DBI 修复了影响 RHEL 系统的数据库交互层中的关键缺陷，解决了可能导致后端服务暴露于注入或绕过攻击的不完整缓解措施。

items.reason_en: MIT Kerberos 5 experiences CPU exhaustion denial of service when processing oversized ASN.1 encoded elements in AS-REQ or TGS-REQ packets due to inefficient array growth logic.
items.reason_zh: 在处理 AS-REQ 或 TGS-REQ 数据包中过大的 ASN.1 编码元素时，MIT Kerberos 5 因低效的数组扩容逻辑导致 CPU 耗尽型拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests in MIT Kerberos 5 allocate persistent client state in kadmind, leading to severe memory exhaustion and service disruption.
items.reason_zh: MIT Kerberos 5 中反复失败的 AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT 请求会在 kadmind 中分配持久化客户端状态，导致严重的内存耗尽和服务中断。

items.reason_en: RESTEasy's SourceProvider allows unauthenticated remote file reads by processing crafted XML bodies with DOCTYPE declarations that reference external entities on vulnerable endpoints.
items.reason_zh: RESTEasy 的 SourceProvider 可通过处理包含引用易受攻击端点外部实体的 DOCTYPE 声明的构造 XML 主体，实现未认证远程文件读取。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow during PostgreSQL array modification enables authenticated users to execute arbitrary code, compromising database integrity.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 数组修改过程中的整数溢出可使已认证用户执行任意代码，破坏数据库完整性。

items.reason_en: Ping endpoint in Apache Solr can trigger privileged operations under rule-based authorization, bypassing security controls in search deployments.
items.reason_zh: Apache Solr 的 Ping 端点在基于规则的授权下可触发特权操作，从而绕过搜索部署中的安全控制。

items.reason_en: SpEL evaluation before placeholder replacement in Spring Data Elasticsearch allows remote code execution via crafted query arguments.
items.reason_zh: Spring Data Elasticsearch 在占位符替换前进行 SpEL 求值，允许通过构造查询参数实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in OTRS survey endpoint allows attackers to manipulate helpdesk database contents and extract sensitive ticket data.
items.reason_zh: OTRS 调查端点存在未认证 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者可操纵帮助台数据库内容并提取敏感工单数据。

items.reason_en: Correctly marks inodes as preallocated for pNFS writes past EOF, preventing metadata corruption and unauthorized block allocation in distributed storage.
items.reason_zh: 正确将 pNFS 超出 EOF 写入操作的 inode 标记为预分配，防止分布式存储中的元数据损坏和未经授权的块分配。

items.reason_en: Refuses LAYOUTCOMMIT requests for ranges without allocated blocks, stopping NFSv4.1 clients from forcing unintended disk allocations.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝针对未分配块范围的 LAYOUTCOMMIT 请求，阻止 NFSv4.1 客户端强制进行非预期的磁盘分配。

items.reason_en: Clamps inline data length during Ceph message parsing, preventing out-of-bounds reads from untrusted metadata server replies.
items.reason_zh: 在解析 Ceph 消息时限制内联数据长度，防止从不信任的元数据服务器响应中进行越界读取。

items.reason_en: Rejects mdsmaps claiming excessive ranks, preventing integer overflows and memory corruption in Ceph cluster coordination daemons.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝声称包含过多秩的 mdsmaps，防止 Ceph 集群协调守护进程中发生整数溢出和内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Holds distributed lock references across grant AST enqueue, preventing use-after-free vulnerabilities in OCFS2 clustering middleware.
items.reason_zh: 在授予 AST 入队期间保持分布式锁引用，防止 OCFS2 集群中间件中出现释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Prevents session slot modification during cached NFS reply replay, ensuring protocol state integrity and blocking session hijacking attempts.
items.reason_zh: 防止在缓存 NFS 响应重放期间修改会话槽位，确保协议状态完整性并阻断会话劫持尝试。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write during extended attribute alignment processing in the ksmbd SMB server allows remote attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution on file-sharing appliances.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd SMB 服务器在处理扩展属性对齐时的越界写入漏洞，允许远程攻击者在文件共享设备上实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free during blocked-lock reaping in the NFSD NFS server can be exploited remotely to crash the service or escalate privileges on network storage systems.
items.reason_zh: NFSD NFS 服务器在回收阻塞锁期间的释放后使用漏洞可被远程利用，导致服务崩溃或在网络存储系统上提权。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Tanium's Default Content module allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on managed enterprise endpoints, bypassing intended security controls.
items.reason_zh: Tanium 的 Default Content 模块存在命令注入漏洞，攻击者可绕过预期安全控制在受管企业终端上执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded JWT verification key in AutoGPT Platform completely undermines OAuth token encryption, enabling trivial account takeover across all user sessions.
items.reason_zh: AutoGPT Platform 中硬编码的 JWT 验证密钥完全破坏了 OAuth 令牌加密机制，使得跨所有用户会话的账户接管变得轻而易举。

items.reason_en: Directory traversal via the image parameter in monailabel leads to remote code execution and is actively exploited in the wild against medical imaging workflows.
items.reason_zh: monailabel 的 image 参数存在目录遍历漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，且已在实际环境中被积极利用以针对医学影像工作流。

items.reason_en: Inadequate configuration validation in X-Road Security Server allows ecosystem identifier manipulation during federated updates.
items.reason_zh: X-Road Security Server 的配置验证不足，允许在联邦更新期间操纵生态系统标识符。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 relative path traversal in OpenSSH for Windows enables remote code execution over the network, creating significant risks for cross-platform administrative workflows.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows 存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的相对路径遍历漏洞，可通过网络实现远程代码执行，对跨平台管理流程构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 authorization bypass in Visual Studio Code allows network-based security feature circumvention, directly impacting the security posture of modern developer environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 存在 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的授权绕过漏洞，允许基于网络的特性规避，直接影响现代开发环境的安全态势。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.0 time-of-check time-of-use race condition in the Linux Kernel facilitates local privilege escalation, affecting WSL deployments and hybrid operating system configurations.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核存在 CVSS 评分为 7.0 的检查时使用（TOCTOU）竞争条件漏洞，可导致本地提权，影响 WSL 部署及混合操作系统配置。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows Raw Image Extension allows network-based remote code execution, targeting peripheral and imaging software.
items.reason_zh: Windows Raw Image Extension 存在整数溢出漏洞，支持基于网络的远程代码执行，主要影响外设与成像软件。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the XPS Document Converter enables network-based remote code execution, affecting document printing workflows.
items.reason_zh: XPS Document Converter 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，支持基于网络的远程代码执行，影响文档打印流程。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows TPM driver allows local privilege escalation, potentially bypassing hardware security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows TPM 驱动程序存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致本地提权，可能绕过硬件安全边界。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the USB Audio Class driver enables local privilege escalation, impacting audio subsystem stability.
items.reason_zh: USB Audio Class 驱动程序存在整数下溢漏洞，可导致本地提权，影响音频子系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Enterprise App Management allows network privilege escalation, complicating application lifecycle security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Enterprise App Management 中的释放后使用漏洞可导致网络权限提升，增加了应用生命周期的安全风险。

items.reason_en: Incorrect numeric type conversion in Microsoft JScript allows remote code execution, impacting legacy scripting environments and automation tools relying on the engine.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft JScript 中的错误数值类型转换可导致远程代码执行，影响依赖该引擎的遗留脚本环境与自动化工具。

items.reason_en: Local command injection in Visual Studio Code enables privilege escalation, posing a threat to developers who may inadvertently execute malicious scripts through the IDE.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的本地命令注入漏洞可实现权限提升，对可能通过 IDE 意外执行恶意脚本的开发者构成威胁。

items.reason_en: UI misrepresentation in Visual Studio Code allows attackers to bypass security prompts, threatening developer toolchain integrity and supply chain security.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的界面欺骗漏洞可使攻击者绕过安全提示，威胁开发工具链完整性与供应链安全。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in OpenSSH for Windows enables remote code execution, compromising secure shell access for Windows server management.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及用于 Windows 服务器管理的 SSH 访问安全。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Xbox Gaming Services allows local privilege escalation, indicating broader security gaps in Microsoft's gaming ecosystem.
items.reason_zh: Xbox Gaming Services 中的授权不当漏洞可导致本地权限提升，表明微软游戏生态系统存在更广泛的安全缺陷。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Python allows local privilege escalation, affecting cross-platform development and scripting environments.
items.reason_zh: Python 中的权限管理不当漏洞可导致本地权限提升，影响跨平台开发与脚本环境。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized network code execution. Compromising widely adopted development environments jeopardizes software supply chains.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的代码注入漏洞允许未经授权的远程代码执行。破坏广泛使用的开发环境将危及软件供应链。

items.reason_en: Trust boundary violation in Visual Studio Code enables network security feature bypass. Attackers can circumvent IDE sandboxing and extension restrictions.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的信任边界违规漏洞可导致网络安全功能被绕过。攻击者可规避 IDE 沙箱机制与扩展限制。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Visual Studio Code permits network code execution. Weak plugin and workspace isolation models increase developer risk exposure.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的访问控制不当漏洞允许远程代码执行。插件与工作区隔离模型薄弱会增加开发者风险暴露面。

items.reason_en: Insertion of sensitive information into Aspire logs allows local information disclosure. Plaintext credential logging creates persistent data leakage risks.
items.reason_zh: 敏感信息写入 Aspire 日志可导致本地信息泄露。明文凭据记录会造成长期的数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Externally-controlled format string in Windows Image Acquisition enables local privilege escalation. Peripheral management services become vulnerable to memory corruption attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Image Acquisition 中的外部可控格式字符串漏洞可导致本地权限提升。外设管理服务易受内存破坏攻击。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in Microsoft Defender bypasses core endpoint protection mechanisms, leaving systems vulnerable to malware execution.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Defender 中的权限提升漏洞可绕过核心端点保护机制，使系统易受恶意软件执行攻击。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Visual Studio Code allows attackers to bypass local security features, impacting developer environments and CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的代码注入漏洞允许攻击者绕过本地安全功能，影响开发环境与 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Word enables unauthenticated network-based code execution via crafted documents, a common initial attack vector.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Word 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过构造文档实现未认证的远程代码执行，此为常见的初始攻击向量。

items.reason_en: Code injection vulnerability in Visual Studio Code allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, compromising developer environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的代码注入漏洞允许未认证的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，从而破坏开发环境。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Skype for Business facilitates network spoofing attacks targeting adjacent users, undermining communication trust.
items.reason_zh: Skype for Business 中的加密签名验证不当漏洞助长针对相邻用户的网络欺骗攻击，破坏通信信任基础。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in OpenSSH for Windows enables local privilege escalation, impacting hybrid IT environments increasingly reliant on cross-platform SSH automation.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，影响日益依赖跨平台 SSH 自动化的混合 IT 环境。

items.reason_en: Security feature bypass in Visual Studio Code Copilot Chat Extension allows unauthorized network access. This threatens developer workflows and introduces risks to AI-assisted coding environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code Copilot Chat Extension 中的安全功能绕过漏洞允许未经授权的远程访问。此举威胁开发者工作流，并向 AI 辅助编码环境引入风险。

items.reason_en: Incomplete input validation in Visual Studio Code enables local security feature bypass. Poses risks to IDE integrity and undermines plugin sandboxing mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的输入验证不完整漏洞可导致本地安全功能被绕过。此举威胁 IDE 完整性并削弱插件沙箱机制。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in Microsoft HPC Pack enables unauthenticated remote code execution. Scientific computing clusters and research environments often run legacy protocols, making this a high-impact target.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft HPC Pack 中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行。科学计算集群与研究环境常运行遗留协议，使其成为高影响目标。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows Management Instrumentation allows local privilege escalation. WMI is heavily leveraged by IT automation and endpoint management tools, increasing the blast radius of successful exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows Management Instrumentation 中的竞态条件漏洞可导致本地权限提升。WMI 被 IT 自动化与端点管理工具广泛使用，成功利用将扩大攻击影响范围。

items.reason_en: SSRF in PowerShell Core enables network reconnaissance and data leakage from internal services accessed via automated scripting workflows.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell Core 中的 SSRF 漏洞允许进行网络侦察，并从通过自动化脚本工作流访问的内部服务中泄露数据。

items.reason_en: Weak cryptographic signature verification in the Windows Key Distribution Center allows attackers to forge Kerberos tickets and escalate domain privileges.
items.reason_zh: Windows Key Distribution Center 中的弱加密签名验证漏洞允许攻击者伪造 Kerberos 票据并提升域权限。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Visual Studio enables network-based code execution, exploiting unsafe object reconstruction patterns common in development toolchains.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio 中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，利用了开发工具链中常见的不安全对象重建模式。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in Visual Studio allows network code execution, targeting IDE components with high-impact memory corruption vulnerabilities.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程代码执行，主要针对具有高危内存破坏漏洞的 IDE 组件。

items.reason_en: A TOCTOU race condition in the .NET framework allows local privilege escalation, demonstrating persistent synchronization flaws in cross-platform runtime environments.
items.reason_zh: .NET framework 中的 TOCTOU 竞态条件漏洞可导致本地权限提升，表明跨平台运行时环境中存在持续的同步缺陷。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in AzuraCast's Liquidsoap integration allows arbitrary command execution (CVSS 8.8). Media managers can break out of sandboxed annotation strings to compromise streaming server infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: AzuraCast 的 Liquidsoap 集成中存在 OS 命令注入漏洞，允许任意命令执行（CVSS 8.8）。媒体管理器可突破沙箱注释字符串限制，进而破坏流媒体服务器基础设施。

items.reason_en: Authentication secret leakage in @better-auth/electron exposes social provider credentials (CVSS 8.1). Authenticated users can extract full endpoint contexts and bypass intended OAuth security controls.
items.reason_zh: @better-auth/electron 中的认证密钥泄露漏洞会暴露社交提供商凭据（CVSS 8.1）。已认证用户可提取完整的端点上下文并绕过预期的 OAuth 安全控制。

items.reason_en: Symlink traversal in Linux X-mount.subdir bypasses filesystem isolation (CVSS 7.0). Local unprivileged users can escape mounted boundaries to access restricted host system resources.
items.reason_zh: Linux X-mount.subdir 中的符号链接遍历漏洞可绕过文件系统隔离（CVSS 7.0）。本地非特权用户可逃逸挂载边界以访问受限的主机系统资源。

items.reason_en: Gammapy passes user-supplied FITS header values directly to Python's eval() function, enabling code injection when processing malicious astronomical data files.
items.reason_zh: Gammapy 将用户提供的 FITS 头值直接传递给 Python 的 eval() 函数，在处理恶意天文数据文件时可导致代码注入。

items.reason_en: Hermes AI Agent reads backend-writable screen environment variables when hosted in non-local terminals, risking credential leakage or environment manipulation.
items.reason_zh: 当部署在非本地终端时，Hermes AI Agent 会读取后端可写的 screen 环境变量，存在凭据泄露或环境被篡改的风险。

items.reason_en: Assimp library contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability during glTF 1.0 asset import, allowing attackers to corrupt heap or stack memory via oversized accessor elements.
items.reason_zh: Assimp 库在导入 glTF 1.0 资产时存在越界写入漏洞，攻击者可通过过大的 accessor 元素破坏堆或栈内存。

items.reason_en: Information disclosure in pypdf allows attackers to guess and recover hidden placeholders in encrypted templates by analyzing cross-document file identifiers.
items.reason_zh: pypdf 的信息泄露漏洞允许攻击者通过分析跨文档文件标识符来猜测并恢复加密模板中的隐藏占位符。

items.reason_en: Direct SQL injection in the SourceCodester e-commerce platform's order management module risks complete database compromise and credential theft.
items.reason_zh: SourceCodester 电商平台订单管理模块中存在直接 SQL 注入漏洞，可能导致数据库完全沦陷及凭据被盗。

items.reason_en: Crafted PDFs with self-referencing AcroForm structures trigger uncatchable stack overflows during parsing, causing reliable application crashes and denial of service.
items.reason_zh: 包含自引用 AcroForm 结构的构造型 PDF 在解析时会触发无法捕获的栈溢出，导致应用程序确定性地崩溃及服务拒绝。

items.reason_en: ansible-core constructs git clone commands without end-of-options separators before user-supplied URLs, enabling command injection when installing collections from malicious git sources.
items.reason_zh: ansible-core 在拼接用户提供的 URL 前未使用选项结束分隔符构建 git clone 命令，从恶意 git 源安装集合时可导致命令注入。

items.reason_en: bootc and ostree finalize already-staged deployments without revalidating container signatures against hardened policies, leaving systems bootable with previously staged unsigned OS content.
items.reason_zh: bootc 和 ostree 在未根据加固策略重新验证容器签名的情况下提交已暂存的部署，导致系统仍可引导之前暂存的未签名操作系统内容。

items.reason_en: ansible.posix authorized_key module uses os.chown() instead of os.lchown() and opens files without O_NOFOLLOW, allowing local users to pre-stage symlinks for privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: ansible.posix 的 authorized_key 模块使用 os.chown() 而非 os.lchown()，且打开文件时未指定 O_NOFOLLOW 标志，允许本地用户预先设置符号链接以实现提权。

items.reason_en: yggdrasil-worker-package-manager misinterprets hyphen-prefixed package names as command-line options in the APT backend, enabling local attackers to inject arguments and modify package management behavior.
items.reason_zh: yggdrasil-worker-package-manager 在 APT 后端中将带连字符前缀的软件包名称误认为命令行选项，使本地攻击者能够注入参数并修改软件包管理行为。

items.reason_en: osCommerce's MultiSafepay payment success callback manipulates customer_id arguments improperly, leading to authentication failures and unauthorized transaction state modifications.
items.reason_zh: osCommerce 的 MultiSafepay 支付成功回调不当处理 customer_id 参数，导致身份验证失败及未经授权的交易状态修改。

items.reason_en: Sophisticated supply chain backdoor in xz/liblzma modifies core system libraries, enabling remote code execution across Linux distributions.
items.reason_zh: xz/liblzma 中发现的高级供应链后门会修改核心系统库，从而实现在各 Linux 发行版上的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Key flag inference discrepancy in sequoia-openpgp allows bypassing back-signature checks, undermining OpenPGP cryptographic integrity.
items.reason_zh: sequoia-openpgp 中密钥标志推断的差异可导致绕过反向签名检查，破坏 OpenPGP 的密码学完整性。

items.reason_en: Improper PKCS#1 padding removal in OpenSSL enables signature forgery, compromising certificate verification for legacy systems.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSL 中不正确的 PKCS#1 填充移除操作可导致签名伪造，危及遗留系统的证书验证。

items.reason_en: Accepting configuration messages in invalid Bluetooth L2CAP states allows peer devices to disrupt channels, causing denial-of-service or state confusion.
items.reason_zh: 在无效的蓝牙 L2CAP 状态下接受配置消息，允许对等设备干扰通道，导致服务拒绝或状态混乱。

items.reason_en: Fixes stale stack pointer usage during page table walks, preventing kernel panics during aggressive memory compaction operations.
items.reason_zh: 修复页表遍历期间使用陈旧栈指针的问题，防止在激进内存压缩操作期间发生内核恐慌。

items.reason_en: Resolves NULL pointer dereference and use-after-free in memory cgroup high watermark handlers, improving system stability under heavy memory pressure.
items.reason_zh: 解决内存 cgroup 高水位线处理器中的空指针解引用和释放后使用问题，提升重内存压力下的系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Fixes use-after-free in NFS lock daemon retry logic, preventing potential privilege escalation through race conditions in lock management.
items.reason_zh: 修复 NFS 锁守护进程重试逻辑中的释放后使用漏洞，防止通过锁管理竞争条件导致潜在提权。

items.reason_en: Rejects unhashed sockets during TCP established lookups, blocking memory reuse attacks targeting lockless socket hash tables.
items.reason_zh: 在 TCP 已建立连接查找期间拒绝未加入哈希表的套接字，阻断针对无锁套接字哈希表的内存重用攻击。

items.reason_en: Correctly credits control-record octets in RPC streams, preventing buffer accounting flaws that could lead to denial-of-service or memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: 正确核算 RPC 流中的控制记录八位组，防止可能导致服务拒绝或内存损坏的缓冲区记账缺陷。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in BPF socket clone early bailouts compromises eBPF program safety, posing significant risks to kernel-level observability and security monitoring tooling.
items.reason_zh: BPF 套接字克隆早期退出机制中的释放后使用漏洞破坏了 eBPF 程序安全性，对内核级可观测性及安全监控工具构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Premature secpath reset during IPsec input processing can bypass policy checks, potentially allowing unauthorized network traffic to traverse secure tunnels undetected.
items.reason_zh: IPsec 输入处理过程中过早重置 secpath 可能绕过策略检查，致使未经授权的网络流量隐蔽穿越安全隧道。
